title.zh: 卷二十上 本紀第二十上: 昭宗
title.raw: 卷二十上 本紀第二十上: 昭宗 Volume 20 Annals 20: Zhaozong

sentences.zh: 昭宗聖穆景文孝皇帝諱曄，懿宗第七子，母曰惠安太后王氏。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhaozong, posthumous title Shengmu Jingwen Xiaoxiao, taboo name Ye, was Yizong's seventh son; his mother was Empress Hui'an, née Wang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaozong—taboo Ye—was Yizong's seventh son, born of Empress Hui'an Wang.

sentences.zh: 以咸通八年二月二十二日生於東內。

translations.literal: On the twenty-second day of the second month of Xiantong 8 he was born in the Eastern Inner Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He was born in the Eastern Palace on Xiantong 8's second-month twenty-second.

sentences.zh: 十三年四月，封壽王，名傑。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the thirteenth year he was enfeoffed as Prince of Shou; his name was Jie.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year thirteen he became Prince of Shou, born Jie.

sentences.zh: 乾符四年，授開府儀同三司、幽州大都督、幽州盧龍等軍節度、押奚契丹、管內觀察處置等使。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Qianfu he was appointed Grand Preceptor of the Palace with the ceremonial of the Three Excellencies, Grand Governor of Youzhou, military commissioner of Youzhou and Lulong and other circuits, commissioner over the Xi and Khitan, and commissioner for observation and disposition within the circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianfu 4 he received Grand Preceptor of the Palace with Three Excellencies honors, Youzhou grand governor, and the Lulong military commission with Xi–Khitan and circuit oversight.

sentences.zh: 帝于僖宗，母弟也，尤相親睦。

translations.literal: To Emperor Xizong he was a younger brother by the same mother, and they were especially close.
translations.idiomatic: He and Xizong shared a mother and were especially close.

sentences.zh: 自艱難播越，嘗隨侍左右，握兵中要，皆奇而愛之。

translations.literal: From the time hardship drove the court into exile he had often attended at the emperor's side; those who held the keys of military power all regarded him as extraordinary and cherished him.
translations.idiomatic: Through the exile years he stayed at Xizong's side; commanders of the armies all prized him.

sentences.zh: 文德元年二月，僖宗暴不豫。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Wende, Xizong was suddenly taken ill.
translations.idiomatic: In Wende 1, second month, Xizong fell suddenly ill.

sentences.zh: 時初復宮闈，人心傾矚，遽聞被疾，軍民駭愕。

translations.literal: The palace had only just been restored and all hearts were turned toward it; word of sudden illness spread at once, and soldiers and civilians were struck with alarm.
translations.idiomatic: The palace had barely been restored when sudden illness spread alarm through army and city.

sentences.zh: 及大漸之夕，而未知所立。

translations.literal: On the night he grew critically ill, it was still unknown who would be enthroned.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of his crisis, the succession was still unsettled.

sentences.zh: 群臣以吉王最賢，又在壽王之上，將立之，唯軍容楊復恭請以壽王監國。

translations.literal: The ministers held that Prince Ji was the most worthy and ranked above Prince Shou; they were about to install him, but only Army Commander Yang Fugong asked that Prince Shou supervise the state as regent.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers favored the worthy Prince Ji, who outranked Prince Shou, but Army Commander Yang Fugong insisted Prince Shou act as regent.

sentences.zh: 三月六日，宣遺詔立為皇太弟。

translations.literal: On the sixth day of the third month the testamentary edict proclaimed him Imperial Younger Brother and heir.
translations.idiomatic: On the third month's sixth the testament named him heir as Imperial Younger Brother.

sentences.zh: 八日，柩前即位，時年二十二。

translations.literal: On the eighth day he took the throne before the coffin; he was twenty-two.
translations.idiomatic: He acceded before the bier on the eighth; he was twenty-two.

sentences.zh: 以司空韋昭度攝塚宰。

translations.literal: The Minister of Works Wei Zhaodu served as acting Grand Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zhaodu of the Works Ministry acted as Grand Minister.

sentences.zh: 己丑，見群臣，始聽政。

translations.literal: On the day jichou he received the ministers; he began to hear government.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he met the court and began to rule.

sentences.zh: 帝攻書好文，尤重儒術，神氣雄俊，有會昌之遺風。

translations.literal: The emperor was skilled at writing and loved literature, especially valued Confucian learning, bore a heroic and handsome air, and retained something of the Huichang legacy.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote well, loved letters, honored Confucian learning, and carried Huichang's martial bearing.

sentences.zh: 以先朝威武不振，國命浸微而尊禮大臣，詳延道術，意在恢張舊業，號令天下。

translations.literal: Because the previous reign's martial prestige had waned and the dynastic mandate had grown faint, he honored great ministers and widely sought men of the Way, intending to restore the old enterprise and command the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing Tang's might fade, he honored ministers and sought scholars, aiming to revive the dynasty and command the realm.

sentences.zh: 即位之始，中外稱之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of his accession court and countryside alike praised him.
translations.idiomatic: At his accession court and country praised him.

sentences.zh: 四月戊辰朔。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fourth month, wuchen, the new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, wuchen new moon.

sentences.zh: 庚午，追諡聖母惠安太后曰恭獻。

translations.literal: On gengwu the sacred mother Empress Hui'an was posthumously titled Gongxian.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Empress Hui'an was posthumously titled Gongxian.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，河南尹彥張全義以兵襲李罕之于河陽，罕之出據澤州。

translations.literal: On yihai Zhang Quanyi, Intendant of Henan, attacked Li Hanzhi at Heyang with troops; Hanzhi fled and held Ze Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Henan Intendant Zhang Quanyi attacked Li Hanzhi at Heyang; Hanzhi withdrew to Zezhou.

sentences.zh: 魏博衙軍殺其帥樂禎于龍興寺，又擊樂從訓，敗之。

translations.literal: The Weibo headquarters guard killed their commander Yue Zhen at Longxing Temple and also struck Yue Congxun, defeating him.
translations.idiomatic: Weibo guards killed commander Yue Zhen at Longxing Temple and routed Yue Congxun.

sentences.zh: 從訓以殘眾保洹水，為羅宗弁陷其城而殺之。

translations.literal: Congxun held Huan River with his shattered troops; Luo Zongbian seized the city and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Congxun held Huan River with remnants until Luo Zongbian took the city and killed him.

sentences.zh: 壬午，蔡賊孫儒陷揚州，楊行密潰圍而出，據宣州。

translations.literal: On renwu the Cai rebel Sun Ru took Yangzhou; Yang Xingmi broke the encirclement and withdrew to hold Xuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Cai rebel Sun Ru took Yangzhou; Yang Xingmi broke out and held Xuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 孫儒自稱淮南節度，仍率其眾攻宣州。

translations.literal: Sun Ru styled himself Huainan military commissioner and still led his host to attack Xuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Ru claimed Huainan and marched on Xuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉朔，制以宣武軍節度使、檢校侍中、沛郡王硃全忠為蔡州四面行營兵馬都統。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fifth month, dingyou, an edict appointed Xuanwu military commissioner, acting Palace Attendant, Prince of Pei Zhu Quanzhong as overall commander of the encircling armies against Cai Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month dingyou new moon: Zhu Quanzhong of Xuanwu was made overall commander against Cai.

sentences.zh: 自秦賢、石璠敗後，蔡賊漸弱，時溥方為全忠所攻，故移溥都統之命授全忠。

translations.literal: After Qin Xian and Shi Fan were defeated the Cai rebels grew weaker; Shi Pu was then under attack from Quanzhong, so Pu's overall command was transferred to Quanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: With Cai weakening after Qin Xian and Shi Fan's defeat, Pu's command passed to Quanzhong while Pu was under attack.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，蔡賊將偽署荊襄節度使趙德諲遣使歸朝，願討賊自效，乃以德諲為蔡州四面行營副都統，德諲遂以荊襄之兵屬全忠。

translations.literal: On renyin the Cai rebel general who had falsely been made Jingxiang military commissioner Zhao Dexun sent envoys to submit to the court, offering to attack the rebels to prove loyalty; Dexun was therefore made deputy overall commander of the Cai encirclement, and he placed his Jingxiang troops under Quanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Zhao Dexun, Cai general turned Jingxiang commissioner, submitted and offered service; made deputy commander, he placed Jingxiang troops under Quanzhong.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯朔，以川賊王建大亂，劍南陳敬瑄告難，制以開府儀同三司、守司空、門下侍郎、同平章事、太清宮使、弘文館大學士、延資庫使、上柱國、扶陽郡開國公，食邑二千戶韋昭度檢校司徒、門下侍郎、平章事，兼成都尹，充劍南西川節度副大使、知節度事，兼兩川招撫制置等使。

translations.literal: On the first day of the sixth month, dingmao, because the Sichuan rebel Wang Jian had thrown the region into chaos and Chen Jingxuan of Jiannan reported distress, an edict appointed Grand Preceptor of the Palace with the ceremonial of the Three Excellencies, acting Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Chancellery, Associate Grand Councillor, Commissioner of the Grand Pure Palace, University Fellow of the Hongwen Institute, Commissioner of the Extended Resources Store, Supreme Pillar of State, Duke of Fuyang with a fief of two thousand households Wei Zhaodu as acting Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Chancellery, Grand Councillor, concurrent Governor of Chengdu, deputy military commissioner of Jiannan West Circuit knowing circuit affairs, and commissioner for pacification and disposition of the two circuits and other duties.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month dingmao new moon: with Wang Jian ravaging Sichuan, Wei Zhaodu was sent west as Grand Councillor and Chengdu governor to pacify Jiannan.

sentences.zh: 蔡州行營奏大破賊于龍陂，進軍以逼賊城。

translations.literal: The Cai encampment reported a great defeat of the rebels at Longpo and an advance to press the rebel city.
translations.idiomatic: The Cai front reported crushing the rebels at Longpo and closing on the city.

sentences.zh: 七月丙申朔，澤州刺史李罕之引太原之師攻河陽，為汴將丁會所敗，退還高平。

translations.literal: On the first day of the seventh month, bingshen, Ze Prefecture governor Li Hanzhi led Taiyuan troops to attack Heyang, was defeated by Bian commander Ding Hui, and retreated to Gaoping.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month bingshen new moon: Li Hanzhi of Zezhou attacked Heyang with Taiyuan troops, was beaten by Ding Hui, and fled to Gaoping.

sentences.zh: 九月乙未，汴將硃珍敗時溥之師於埇橋，遂陷宿州，自是溥嬰城不敢復出。

translations.literal: On the fifteenth day of the ninth month, yiwei, Bian commander Zhu Zhen defeated Shi Pu's army at Yongqiao, then took Suzhou; from then on Pu held his walls and dared not come out again.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month yiwei: Zhu Zhen routed Shi Pu at Yongqiao and took Suzhou; Pu then held his walls.

sentences.zh: 汴將胡元琮急攻蔡州。

translations.literal: Bian commander Hu Yuancong pressed the attack on Cai Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Yuancong of Bian pressed Cai Prefecture hard.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子朔，蔡州牙將申叢執秦宗權，撾折其足，乞降。

translations.literal: On the first day of the twelfth month, jiazi, Cai Prefecture guard officer Shen Cong seized Qin Zongquan, broke his legs, and begged to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month jiazi new moon: Cai officer Shen Cong seized Qin Zongquan, broke his legs, and offered surrender.

sentences.zh: 詔中使宣諭，便以叢權知留後。

translations.literal: An edict sent a palace envoy to proclaim the order; Cong was at once given acting authority as military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: An envoy announced the edict and made Cong acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 比中使至，別將郭璠殺申叢，篡宗權，縶送汴州。

translations.literal: Before the envoy arrived, another officer Guo Fan killed Shen Cong, usurped Zongquan, bound him, and sent him to Bian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Before the envoy arrived Guo Fan killed Cong, seized Zongquan, and sent him to Bianzhou.

sentences.zh: 蔡、申、光等州平。

translations.literal: Cai, Shen, and Guang prefectures were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Cai, Shen, and Guang were pacified.

sentences.zh: 詔賜蔡州行營兵士錢二十五萬貫，令度支逐近支給。

translations.literal: An edict granted the Cai encampment soldiers two hundred fifty thousand strings of cash, ordering the Revenue Bureau to disburse it in the nearest installments.
translations.idiomatic: The court granted the Cai armies 250,000 strings, to be paid from the nearest treasury.

sentences.zh: 是月，葬僖宗於靖陵。

translations.literal: That month Xizong was buried at Jing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: That month Xizong was buried at Jingling.

sentences.zh: 龍紀元年春正月癸巳朔，上御武德殿受朝賀，宣制大赦，改元。

translations.literal: In the first year of Longji, in the first year of Longji, spring, first month, on the day guisi the new moon, the emperor attended court at Wude Hall to receive congratulations, proclaimed an amnesty edict, and changed the reign era.
translations.idiomatic: Longji 1, spring, first month guisi new moon: court at Wude Hall, great amnesty, new era.

sentences.zh: 中外文武臣僚進秩頒爵有差。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials at court and in the provinces were promoted and enfeoffed in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Officials at court and in the provinces received graded promotions and fiefs.

sentences.zh: 以劍南西川節度、兩川招撫制置使韋昭度檢校司空，為東都留守；

translations.literal: Jiannan West military commissioner and commissioner for pacification of the two circuits Wei Zhaodu was made acting Minister of Works and Eastern Capital regent;
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zhaodu of Jiannan West was made acting Minister of Works and Luoyang regent;

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士承旨、兵部侍郎、知制誥劉崇望本官同平章事；

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician-in-Chief, Vice Minister of War, and drafter of edicts Liu Chongwang was confirmed in office as Associate Grand Councillor;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Chongwang, Hanlin chief and War vice minister, became Associate Grand Councillor;

sentences.zh: 以刑部侍郎孫揆為京兆尹。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Justice Sun Kui was made Intendant of Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Kui of Justice became Jingzhao Intendant.

sentences.zh: 二月癸亥朔。

translations.literal: Second month, guihai new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Second month opened on guihai.

sentences.zh: 己丑，汴州行軍司馬李璠監送逆賊秦宗權並妻趙氏以獻，上御延喜門受俘，百僚稱賀，以之徇市，告廟社，斬于獨柳。

translations.literal: On jichou Bian Prefecture marching chief Li Fan supervised the delivery of the rebel Qin Zongquan and his wife Lady Zhao as captives; the emperor received the prisoners at Yanxi Gate, the hundred officials offered congratulations, they were paraded through the market, reported to the ancestral temple and altars, and beheaded at Duli.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Li Fan of Bian delivered Qin Zongquan and Lady Zhao; the emperor took them at Yanxi Gate, paraded and executed them at Duli after rites at temple and altars.

sentences.zh: 趙氏笞死。

translations.literal: Lady Zhao was beaten to death.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Zhao was flogged to death.

sentences.zh: 初，自諸侯收長安，黃巢東出關，與宗權合。

translations.literal: Earlier, after the feudal lords recovered Chang'an, Huang Chao went east out of the pass and joined with Zongquan.
translations.idiomatic: After the lords recovered Chang'an, Huang Chao fled east and joined Zongquan.

sentences.zh: 巢賊雖平，而宗權之凶徒大集，西至金、商、陝、虢，南極荊、襄，東過淮甸，北侵徐、兗、汴、鄭，幅員數十州。

translations.literal: Though the Chao bandits were pacified, Zongquan's vicious followers gathered in great numbers, reaching west to Jin, Shang, Shan, and Guo, south to Jing and Xiang, east across the Huai region, and north into Xu, Yan, Bian, and Zheng—several dozen prefectures in extent.
translations.idiomatic: Though Chao fell, Zongquan's bands spread across dozens of prefectures from the west through the Huai to Xu and Yan.

sentences.zh: 五六年間，民無耕織，千室之邑，不存一二，歲既凶荒，皆膾人而食，喪亂之酷，未之前聞。

translations.literal: For five or six years the people did not plow or weave; in settlements of a thousand households not one or two remained; the year was famine on famine, and all ate human flesh—the cruelty of the devastation was unheard of before.
translations.idiomatic: Five or six years without farming left thousand-household towns empty; famine drove men to cannibalism on a scale never heard.

sentences.zh: 宗權既平，而硃全忠連兵十萬，吞噬河南，兗、鄆、青、徐之間，血戰不解，唐祚以至於亡。

translations.literal: Once Zongquan was pacified, Zhu Quanzhong maintained a hundred thousand men in continuous warfare, swallowing Henan; between Yan, Yun, Qing, and Xu the bloodshed did not cease—and the Tang mandate was thereby brought to ruin.
translations.idiomatic: After Zongquan fell, Quanzhong's hundred thousand men devoured Henan and bled Yan and Xu until Tang's mandate collapsed.

sentences.zh: 中書奏請以二月二十二日為嘉會節，從之。

translations.literal: The Secretariat memorialized asking that the twenty-second day of the second month be made the Festival of Joyous Assembly; the request was assented to.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat asked to make the second month's twenty-second the Festival of Joyous Assembly; the edict was assented to.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰朔，以右僕射、門下侍郎、同平章事孔緯守司空、太清宮使、弘文館大學士、延資庫使、領諸道鹽鐵轉運等使，以右僕射、門下侍郎、集賢殿大學士杜讓能為左僕射、監修國史、判度支，以中書侍郎、戶部尚書、同平章事張浚為集賢殿大學士、判戶部事。

translations.literal: On the first day of the third month, renchen, Right Vice Director of the Chancellery and Associate Grand Councillor Kong Wei was made acting Minister of Works, Commissioner of the Grand Pure Palace, University Fellow of the Hongwen Institute, Commissioner of the Extended Resources Store, and commissioner of salt and iron transport for all circuits; Right Vice Director Du Rangneng was made Left Vice Director, supervised the national history, and judged Revenue; Vice Director of the Chancellery, Minister of Revenue, and Associate Grand Councillor Zhang Jun was made University Fellow of the Jixian Hall and judged Revenue affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Third month renchen new moon: Kong Wei took Works and salt transport; Du Rangneng became Left Vice Director with history and Revenue; Zhang Jun took Jixian and Revenue.

sentences.zh: 四月壬戌朔，以宣武淮南等節度副大使、知節度事、管內營田觀察處置等使、開府儀同三司、檢校太傅、兼侍中、揚州大都督府長史、汴州刺史、充蔡州四面行營都統、上柱國、沛郡王、食邑四千戶朱全忠為檢校太尉、中書令，進封東平王，仍賜賞軍錢十萬貫。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fourth month, renxu, Zhu Quanzhong, deputy military commissioner of Xuanwu and Huainan and other circuits knowing circuit affairs, commissioner for camp and field observation and disposition within the circuit, Grand Preceptor of the Palace with the ceremonial of the Three Excellencies, acting Grand Tutor, concurrent Palace Attendant, Grand Governor of Yangzhou, prefect of Bian, overall commander of the encircling armies against Cai, Supreme Pillar of State, Prince of Pei with a fief of four thousand households, was made acting Grand Commandant, Director of the Secretariat, advanced to Prince of Dongping, and still granted a reward of one hundred thousand strings for his army.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month renxu new moon: Zhu Quanzhong was made Grand Commandant and Director of the Secretariat, advanced to Prince of Dongping, with 100,000 strings for his army.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰朔，漢州刺史王建陷成都府，遷陳敬瑄於雅州，建自稱西川兵馬留後。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fifth month, renchen, Han Prefecture governor Wang Jian took Chengdu, moved Chen Jingxuan to Ya Prefecture, and styled himself acting military commissioner of Xichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month renchen new moon: Wang Jian took Chengdu, exiled Chen Jingxuan to Ya, and claimed Xichuan.

sentences.zh: 復用田令孜為監軍。

translations.literal: Tian Lingzi was again employed as army supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Lingzi was restored as army supervisor.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉朔，邢洺節度使孟方立卒，三軍推其弟洺州刺史遷為留後，太原李克用出軍攻之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the sixth month, xinyou, Xing-Min military commissioner Meng Fangli died; the three armies pushed his brother Qian, prefect of Min, as acting commissioner; Taiyuan's Li Keyong sent troops to attack.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month xinyou new moon: Meng Fangli of Xing-Min died; the army made his brother Qian acting commissioner; Li Keyong attacked.

sentences.zh: 杭州刺史錢鏐攻宣州，下之，擒劉浩，剖心以祭周寶。

translations.literal: Hang Prefecture prefect Qian Liu attacked Xuan Prefecture, took it, captured Liu Hao, and cut out his heart to sacrifice to Zhou Bao.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Liu of Hangzhou took Xuanzhou, captured Liu Hao, and sacrificed his heart to Zhou Bao.

sentences.zh: 七月，詔于杭州置武勝軍，以鏐為本軍防禦觀察等使。

translations.literal: In the seventh month an edict established the Wusheng Army at Hangzhou and made Liu commissioner for defense and observation of that army.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Wusheng Army was set up at Hangzhou and Liu made its commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十月己未朔，青州節度使王敬武卒。

translations.literal: On the first day of the tenth month, jiwei, Qing military commissioner Wang Jingwu died.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month jiwei new moon: Wang Jingwu of Qingzhou died.

sentences.zh: 制以特進、太子少師、博陵郡開國侯、食邑一千戶崔安潛檢校太傅、兼侍中、青州刺史、平盧軍節度觀察、押新羅渤海兩蕃等使。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Special Advancement, Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent, Marquis of Boling with a fief of one thousand households Cui Anqian as acting Grand Tutor, concurrent Palace Attendant, prefect of Qing, military commissioner and observer of Pinglu, and commissioner over the two foreign states Silla and Parhae.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Anqian was made acting Grand Tutor, Qing prefect, and Pinglu commissioner with charge over Silla and Parhae.

sentences.zh: 青州三軍以敬武子師範權知兵馬事。

translations.literal: Qingzhou's three armies had Jingwu's son Shifan act as temporary commander of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Qingzhou troops had Shifan act as temporary commander.

sentences.zh: 十一月己丑朔，將有事於圓丘。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eleventh month, jichou, rites were to be performed at the Round Mound.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month jichou new moon: rites at the Round Mound were planned.

sentences.zh: 改禦名曰曄。

translations.literal: The emperor's personal name was changed to Ye.
translations.idiomatic: His taboo personal name was fixed as Ye.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，上宿齋于武德殿，宰相百僚朝服於位。

translations.literal: On xinhai the emperor kept vigil at Wude Hall; the chief ministers and hundred officials wore court dress at their posts.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the emperor fasted at Wude Hall; ministers wore court dress.

sentences.zh: 時兩軍中尉楊復恭及兩樞密皆朝服侍上，太常博士錢珝、李綽等奏論之曰：「皇帝赴齋宮，內臣皆服朝服。

translations.literal: At the time the two army commandants Yang Fugong and the two Palace Secretaries all attended in court dress to serve the emperor; the Erudites of the Court of Rites Qian Hui and Li Chuo and others memorialized, saying: "When the emperor goes to the fasting palace, inner attendants all wear court dress.
translations.idiomatic: Both army commandants Yang Fugong and both Palace Secretaries attended in court dress; Ritual Erudites Qian Hui and Li Chuo objected: "When the emperor enters the fasting palace, eunuchs wear court dress.

sentences.zh: 臣檢國朝故事及近代禮令，並無內官朝服助祭之文。

translations.literal: Your subjects have examined the dynastic precedents and recent ritual regulations and find no text allowing inner officials court dress to assist at sacrifice."
translations.idiomatic: We find no precedent or recent statute allowing eunuchs court dress at sacrifice."

sentences.zh: 伏惟皇帝陛下承天禦曆，聖祚中興，祗見宗祧，克陳大禮。

translations.literal: "We humbly consider that Your Majesty, bearing Heaven's mandate, with the sacred reign reviving, reverently approaches the ancestral temple and can perform the great rites.
translations.idiomatic: "Your Majesty revives the sacred reign and approaches the ancestral temple in the great rites.

sentences.zh: 皆稟高祖、太宗之成制，必循虞、夏、商、周之舊經，置冕服章，式遵彝憲。

translations.literal: All follow the completed institutions of Gaozu and Taizong; you must tread the old canons of Yu, Xia, Shang, and Zhou, setting regalia and robes to follow the constant law."
translations.idiomatic: This follows Gaozu and Taizong and the ancient canons—regalia must follow the law."

sentences.zh: 禮院先准大禮使牒稱得內侍省牒，要知內臣朝服品秩，禮院已准禮令報訖。

translations.literal: "The Ritual Office had earlier approved the Grand Ritual Commissioner's memorandum stating that the Inner Service had sent a note asking the rank of inner officials' court dress; the Ritual Office had already replied according to ritual regulations."
translations.idiomatic: "The Ritual Office had answered the Inner Service on eunuchs' court dress per statute."

sentences.zh: 今參詳近朝事例，若內官及諸衛將軍必須制冠服，即各依所兼正官，隨資品依令式服本官之服。

translations.literal: "Now examining recent precedents, if inner officials and guards generals must wear regulated caps and robes, each follows his concurrent regular office and wears that office's dress according to rank and formula."
translations.idiomatic: "Recent practice has eunuchs and guard generals wear the dress of their concurrent civil rank."

sentences.zh: 事存傳聽，且可俯從，然亦不分明著在禮令。

translations.literal: "The matter rests on hearsay and may be indulged for the moment, yet it is not clearly set down in ritual regulations."
translations.idiomatic: "That is hearsay indulgence, not clear law."

sentences.zh: 乞聖慈允臣所奏。

translations.literal: "We beg Your Sage Mercy to grant our memorial."
translations.idiomatic: "We beg Your Majesty to grant our memorial."

sentences.zh: 」狀入，至晚不報。

translations.literal: The memorial entered; by evening there was no reply.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was filed; by evening no reply came.

sentences.zh: 錢珝又進狀曰：「臣今日巳時進狀，論內官冠服制度，未奉聖旨。

translations.literal: Qian Hui submitted another memorial, saying: "Your subject today at the si hour submitted a memorial discussing inner officials' caps and robes; no imperial order has yet been received.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Hui submitted again: "Today at si hour I discussed eunuchs' dress; no order has come.

sentences.zh: 伏以陛下虔事郊禋，式遵彝范，凡關典禮，必守憲章。

translations.literal: We consider that Your Majesty devoutly performs the suburban sacrifice and follows the constant model; every matter of canonical rite must keep to the statutes."
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty performs the suburban rites and must keep every canonical matter to statute."

sentences.zh: 今陛下行先王之大禮，而內臣遂服先王之法服。

translations.literal: "Now Your Majesty performs the great rites of the former kings, yet inner attendants then wear the former kings' regulated robes."
translations.idiomatic: "You perform the former kings' great rites while eunuchs wear the former kings' robes."

sentences.zh: 來日朝獻大聖祖，臣贊導皇帝行事，若侍臣服章有違制度，是為非禮，上瀆祖宗，臣期不奉敕。

translations.literal: "Tomorrow at the presentation to the Great Sage Ancestor your subject will guide the emperor in the rites; if attendants' dress violates the regulations, that is unritual and profanes the ancestors—your subject expects not to accept the order.
translations.idiomatic: "Tomorrow I guide the presentation; if attendants' dress breaks rule, I will not accept the order—it profanes the ancestors.

sentences.zh: 臣謬當聖代，叨備禮官，獲正朝儀，死且不朽，脂膏泥滓，是所甘心。

translations.literal: Your subject is unworthily placed in this sage age, holding a ritual office; to correct court ceremony, death would not be forgotten; grease and mud are gladly given."
translations.idiomatic: I hold a ritual office in a sage age; to correct court ceremony I would gladly die."

sentences.zh: 」狀入，降硃書禦劄曰：「卿等所論至當，事可從權。

translations.literal: The memorial entered; an edict in vermilion imperial script was issued, saying: "What you have argued is entirely correct; the matter may follow expedient authority.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial entered; vermilion script replied: "Your argument is correct; expedient authority may apply.

sentences.zh: 勿以小瑕，遂妨大禮。

translations.literal: Do not let a small flaw obstruct the great rite."
translations.idiomatic: Do not let a small flaw block the great rite."

sentences.zh: 」於是內四臣遂以法服侍祠。

translations.literal: Thereupon the four inner ministers wore regulated dress to assist at the sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The four inner ministers then wore regulated dress at the rite.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，圓丘禮畢，禦承天門，大赦。

translations.literal: On jiayin the Round Mound rites were completed; the emperor took the Gate of Accepting Heaven and proclaimed a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the Round Mound rites ended; at Chengtian Gate he proclaimed great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午，宰臣杜讓能兼司空。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu Grand Councillor Du Rangneng was made concurrent Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Du Rangneng was also made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 大順元年春正月戊子朔，禦武德殿受朝賀。

translations.literal: In the first year of Dashun, in the first year of Dashun, spring, first month, on the day wuzi the new moon, the emperor attended court at Wude Hall to receive congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: Dashun 1, spring, first month wuzi new moon: court at Wude Hall.

sentences.zh: 宰臣百僚上徽號曰聖文睿德光武弘孝皇帝，禮畢，大赦，改元大順。

translations.literal: The chief ministers and hundred officials offered a honorific title: Sage, Cultured, Sagacious, Virtuous, Martial, and Filial Emperor; when the rites were complete a great amnesty was proclaimed and the era was changed to Dashun.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers offered the honorific Sage, Cultured, Sagacious, Virtuous, Martial, Filial Emperor; rites done, great amnesty, era Dashun.

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳，宰臣兼國子祭酒孔緯以孔子廟經兵火，有司釋奠無所，請內外文臣自觀察使、制使下及令佐，於本官料錢上緡抽十文，助修國學，從之。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi Grand Councillor and Chancellor of the National University Kong Wei, because Confucius's temple had suffered in the military fires and the officials had nowhere to perform the seasonal offering, asked that civil officials from observation commissioners and commissioners down to magistrates and aides contribute ten cash per string from their official salary to repair the National University; the request was assented to.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Kong Wei asked officials from commissioners down to magistrates to tithe ten cash per salary string to rebuild the National University after war burned Confucius's temple; the edict was assented to.

sentences.zh: 宣武節度使朱全忠進位守中書令，加食邑千戶，餘如故。

translations.literal: Xuanwu military commissioner Zhu Quanzhong was advanced to acting Director of the Secretariat with an added fief of one thousand households; the rest unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Quanzhong of Xuanwu was advanced to acting Secretariat Director with 1,000 added households.

sentences.zh: 太原都將安金俊攻圍邢州歷年，城中食盡，邢洺觀察使孟遷以城降，乃以孟遷之族歸太原。

translations.literal: Taiyuan commander An Jinjun had besieged Xing Prefecture for years; when food in the city was exhausted, Xing-Min observer Meng Qian surrendered the city, and Qian's clan was sent to Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: An Jinjun of Taiyuan besieged Xingzhou until Meng Qian surrendered and his clan was sent to Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 克用以大將安建為邢洺留後。

translations.literal: Keyong made his great general An Jian acting Xing-Min commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Keyong made An Jian acting Xing-Min commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三月丁亥朔，朱全忠上表：「關東籓鎮，請除用朝廷名德為節度觀察使。

translations.literal: On the first day of the third month, dinghai, Zhu Quanzhong submitted a memorial: "Among the eastern circuits' feudal lords, please appoint men of the court's renowned virtue as military commissioners and observers.
translations.idiomatic: Third month dinghai new moon: Zhu Quanzhong memorialized: "Appoint court men of renown as eastern commissioners.

sentences.zh: 如籓臣固位不受代，臣請以兵誅之。

translations.literal: If a feudal minister clings to his post and will not yield to replacement, your subject asks to punish him with troops."
translations.idiomatic: If any refuse replacement, I will punish them by force."

sentences.zh: 如王徽、裴璩、孔晦、崔安潛等皆縉紳名族，踐曆素高，宜用為徐鄆青兗等道節度使。

translations.literal: Men such as Wang Hui, Pei Zan, Kong Hui, and Cui Anqian are all eminent clans of the gentry, long high in office, and should be used as military commissioners of Xu, Yun, Qing, Yan, and other circuits."
translations.idiomatic: Wang Hui, Pei Zan, Kong Hui, and Cui Anqian are fit for Xu, Yun, Qing, and Yan."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The edict was assented to.
translations.idiomatic: The court assented.

sentences.zh: 昭義節度使李克修卒，太原帥克用之弟也，三軍推克修弟克恭知留後事。

translations.literal: Zhaoyi military commissioner Li Kexiu died; he was the younger brother of Taiyuan commander Li Keyong; the three armies pushed Kexiu's younger brother Ke Gong to know acting commissioner affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Li Kexiu of Zhaoyi died—Keyong's brother; the army made Ke Gong acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 四月丙辰朔，李克用遣大將安金俊率師攻雲州。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fourth month, bingchen, Li Keyong sent the great general An Jinjun to lead troops and attack Yun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month bingchen new moon: Keyong sent An Jinjun against Yunzhou.

sentences.zh: 赫連鐸求援于幽州，李匡威出兵援之，戰於蔚州，太原軍大敗，燕軍執安金俊，獻之於朝。

translations.literal: Helian Duo sought aid from Youzhou; Li Kuangwei sent troops to rescue him; they fought at Yu Prefecture; the Taiyuan army was greatly defeated and the Yan army seized An Jinjun and presented him to the court.
translations.idiomatic: Helian Duo called Youzhou; Kuangwei fought at Yuzhou; Taiyuan was crushed and Jinjun was sent to court as captive.

sentences.zh: 李匡威、赫連鐸、硃全忠等上表：「請因沙陀敗亡，臣與河北三鎮及臣所鎮汴滑河陽之兵平定太原，願朝廷命重臣一人都總戎事。

translations.literal: Li Kuangwei, Helian Duo, Zhu Quanzhong, and others submitted memorials: "Now that the Shatuo are defeated and ruined, your subject together with the three Hebei circuits and the troops of the circuits your subject commands—Bian, Hua, Heyang—wish to pacify Taiyuan; we ask that the court appoint one high minister to overall command the military affair."
translations.idiomatic: Kuangwei, Duo, and Quanzhong asked to crush Taiyuan now that Shatuo was broken and begged one chief minister to command.

sentences.zh: 」昭宗以太原于艱難時立興復大功，心疑其事，下兩省、御史台、尚書省四品已上官議。

translations.literal: Zhaozong, because Taiyuan at the time of hardship had rendered great merit in restoring the dynasty, was suspicious in his heart and sent the matter for deliberation to officials of the fourth rank and above in the Two Departments, the Censorate, and the Six Ministries.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaozong, remembering Taiyuan's restoration merit, doubted the plan and referred it to fourth-rank officials and above.

sentences.zh: 唯党全忠者言其可伐，不可者十之七，宰臣杜讓能、劉崇望深以為不可。

translations.literal: Only those in Quanzhong's faction said he could be attacked; seven tenths opposed; chief ministers Du Rangneng and Liu Chongwang deeply held it impossible.
translations.idiomatic: Only Quanzhong's party favored attack; seven in ten opposed; Du Rangneng and Liu Chongwang strongly dissented.

sentences.zh: 惟張浚議曰：「先朝再幸興元，實沙陀之罪。

translations.literal: Only Zhang Jun argued, saying: "In the previous reign, when the court twice reached Xingyuan, it was in truth the Shatuo's crime."
translations.idiomatic: Only Zhang Jun argued: "The court's double exile to Xingyuan was the Shatuo's doing."

sentences.zh: 比慮河北諸侯與之膠固，無以滌除。

translations.literal: I feared the Hebei feudal lords would stick fast to him and there would be no way to wash him away.
translations.idiomatic: I feared Hebei lords would cling to him and he could not be removed.

sentences.zh: 今兩河大籓皆願誅討，不因其離貳而除之，是當斷失斷也。

translations.literal: Now the great circuits of the two Hebei regions all wish to punish him; if we do not destroy him while he is divided and alienated, this is failing to cut when cutting is due.
translations.idiomatic: Both Hebei circuits want him dead; not striking while he is divided is missing the moment.

sentences.zh: 」孔緯曰：「浚言是也。

translations.literal: Kong Wei said: "Jun's words are correct."
translations.idiomatic: Kong Wei said, "Jun is right."

sentences.zh: 」軍容楊復恭曰：「先朝蒙犯霜露，播越草莽，七八年間，寢不安席，雖賊臣搖盪於外，亦由失制於中。

translations.literal: Army Commander Yang Fugong said: "In the previous reign we braved frost and dew, driven into exile in the wilds; for seven or eight years we could not rest in peace. Though rebel ministers shook the outer realm, it was also because control was lost within.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Fugong said, "The last reign braved exile seven or eight years—rebels outside, but control was lost within.

sentences.zh: 陛下纘承，人心忻戴，不宜輕舉干戈，為國生事。

translations.literal: Your Majesty has succeeded; the people's hearts rejoice in you—it is not fitting lightly to raise weapons and create trouble for the state.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty has succeeded and hearts rejoice—do not lightly make war on the state.

sentences.zh: 望優詔報全忠，且以柔服為辭。

translations.literal: I hope a gracious edict may reply to Quanzhong, using gentle compliance in the wording.
translations.idiomatic: Reply gently to Quanzhong.

sentences.zh: 」上然之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 全忠密遣浚之親黨賂浚，浚恃全忠之援，論奏不已，天子黽勉從之。

translations.literal: Quanzhong secretly sent Jun's kin to bribe Jun; Jun relied on Quanzhong's backing and argued without cease in memorials; the Son of Heaven reluctantly assented.
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhong bribed Jun's kin; Jun pressed memorials with Quanzhong's backing until the emperor reluctantly assented.

sentences.zh: 五月，制特進、中書侍郎、兵部尚書、同平章事、集賢殿大學士、上柱國、河間郡開國伯、食邑七百戶張浚為太原四面行營兵馬都統，京兆尹孫揆副之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month an edict appointed Special Advancement, Vice Director of the Chancellery, Minister of War, Associate Grand Councillor, University Fellow of the Jixian Hall, Supreme Pillar of State, Baron of Hejian with a fief of seven hundred households Zhang Jun as overall commander of the encircling armies on four sides of Taiyuan, with Jingzhao Intendant Sun Kui as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: Zhang Jun was made overall commander against Taiyuan; Sun Kui was deputy.

sentences.zh: 以華州節度使韓建為北面行營招討都虞候、供軍等使；

translations.literal: Hua military commissioner Han Jian was made chief adjutant for suppression of the northern encampment and commissioner for army supplies;
translations.idiomatic: Han Jian of Hua was made northern chief adjutant and supply commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以宣武節度使朱全忠為太原東南面招討使；

translations.literal: Xuanwu military commissioner Zhu Quanzhong was made southeastern suppression commissioner against Taiyuan;
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Quanzhong of Xuanwu was made southeastern commissioner;

sentences.zh: 成德軍節度使王鎔為太原東面招討使；

translations.literal: Chengde military commissioner Wang Rong was made eastern suppression commissioner against Taiyuan;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Rong of Chengde was made eastern commissioner;

sentences.zh: 幽州節度使李匡威為太原北面招討使，雲州防禦使赫連鐸副之。

translations.literal: You military commissioner Li Kuangwei was made northern suppression commissioner against Taiyuan, with Yun defense commissioner Helian Duo as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Li Kuangwei of You was northern commissioner; Helian Duo of Yun was deputy.

sentences.zh: 丙午，潞州軍亂，殺其帥李克恭。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu the Lu army mutinied and killed its commander Li Ke Gong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Lu troops mutinied and killed Li Ke Gong.

sentences.zh: 監軍使薛繢本函克恭首獻之於朝，浚方起兵，朝廷稱賀。

translations.literal: Army supervisor Xue Hui had boxed Ke Gong's head and presented it to the court; Jun was just raising troops and the court offered congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: Supervisor Xue Hui sent Ke Gong's head to court as Jun marched; the court celebrated.

sentences.zh: 壬子，都招討使張浚、孫揆率諸策神軍三千赴行營，昭宗禦安喜門臨送，誡誓之。

translations.literal: On the day renzi overall suppression commissioners Zhang Jun and Sun Kui led three thousand of the various elite Shence armies to the encampment; Zhaozong attended at Anxi Gate to see them off and charged them with oaths.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Jun and Sun Kui led three thousand Shence troops to camp; Zhaozong saw them off at Anxi Gate with oaths.

sentences.zh: 六月乙卯，李克用大將權知邢洺兵馬留後安建上表，請以三州歸順，遣中使往勞之。

translations.literal: On the day yimao Li Keyong's great general An Jian, acting Xing-Min commander, submitted a memorial asking to submit the three prefectures and sent a palace envoy to comfort him.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao An Jian, acting Xing-Min commander, offered three prefectures; an envoy was sent to comfort him.

sentences.zh: 制以德州刺史、權知滄州兵馬留後盧彥威檢校尚書右僕射，兼滄州刺史、御史大夫，充義昌軍節度、滄德觀察處置等使。

translations.literal: An edict appointed De Prefecture governor, acting Cangzhou military commissioner Lu Yanwei as acting Right Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Cangzhou prefect and Censor-in-Chief, and military commissioner of Yichang, observer of Cang and De, and commissioner for disposition.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Yanwei of De was made acting Right Vice Director and Yichang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 彥威，光啟初逐其帥楊全玫，求旄節，朝廷以扈蹕都將曹誠為滄德節度使，誠雖不至任，而彥威之請不行。

translations.literal: Yanwei in the beginning of Guangqi drove out his commander Yang Quanmei and sought a commission; the court appointed the imperial escort commander Cao Cheng as Cang-De commissioner—Cheng though never took office, and Yanwei's request was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Yanwei had ousted Yang Quanmei in Guangqi and sought a commission; Cao Cheng was named but never took office.

sentences.zh: 至是，王鎔、羅弘信因張浚用兵，為彥威論請，故有斯授。

translations.literal: Now Wang Rong and Luo Hongxin, because Zhang Jun was using troops, pleaded for Yanwei, and therefore this appointment was made.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Rong and Luo Hongxin pleaded for Yanwei during Jun's campaign and won him the post.

sentences.zh: 以京兆尹、行營兵馬副招討孫揆檢校兵部尚書，兼潞州大都督府長史，充昭義節度副大使、知節度事。

translations.literal: Jingzhao Intendant and deputy overall suppression commissioner Sun Kui was made acting Minister of War, concurrent Grand Governor of Lu Prefecture, deputy military commissioner of Zhaoyi knowing circuit affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Kui was made acting War Minister and Zhaoyi deputy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 張浚會諸軍于晉州，硃全忠選汴卒三千為張浚牙隊。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun assembled the armies at Jin Prefecture; Zhu Quanzhong selected three thousand Bian troops as Jun's guard corps.
translations.idiomatic: Jun gathered armies at Jinzhou; Quanzhong gave him three thousand Bian guards.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙酉朔，王師屯于陰地，太原大將康君立以兵拒戰。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on the day yiyou the new moon, the imperial army encamped at Yindi; Taiyuan great general Kang Junli resisted with troops.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month yiyou new moon: imperial troops camped at Yindi; Kang Junli of Taiyuan resisted.

sentences.zh: 朱全忠遣大將葛從周率千騎入潞州，從周權充兵馬留後。

translations.literal: Zhu Quanzhong sent the great general Ge Congzhou to lead a thousand horsemen into Lu Prefecture; Congzhou acted as temporary military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhong sent Ge Congzhou with a thousand horse into Luzhou as acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 朱全忠奏已差兵士守潞州，請節度使孫揆赴鎮。

translations.literal: Zhu Quanzhong memorialized that troops had already been sent to hold Lu Prefecture and asked that military commissioner Sun Kui proceed to his post.
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhong reported Luzhou held and asked Sun Kui to take the commission.

sentences.zh: 時中使韓歸範押揆旌節、官告送至行營。

translations.literal: At the time the palace envoy Han Guifan escorted Kui's commission, patent of appointment, and announcement to the encampment.
translations.idiomatic: Palace envoy Han Guifan delivered Kui's commission to camp.

sentences.zh: 丙申，揆建節，率兵二千，自晉州赴鎮昭義。

translations.literal: On bingchen Kui raised his standard and led two thousand troops from Jin Prefecture to take up the Zhaoyi commission.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Kui raised his standard and led two thousand from Jinzhou toward Zhaoyi.

sentences.zh: 戊申，至長子縣山谷中。

translations.literal: On wushen he reached the valley of Changzi County.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he entered Changzi valley.

sentences.zh: 太原騎將李存孝伏兵執揆與韓歸範牙兵五百，俘送太原，餘兵悉為存孝所殺。

translations.literal: Taiyuan cavalry commander Li Cunxiao ambushed and seized Kui and Han Guifan with five hundred guard soldiers, sent them captive to Taiyuan, and the rest were all killed by Cunxiao.
translations.idiomatic: Li Cunxiao ambushed Kui and Han Guifan with five hundred guards, sent them to Taiyuan, and killed the rest.

sentences.zh: 太原將康君立率兵二萬攻潞州。

translations.literal: Taiyuan commander Kang Junli led twenty thousand troops to attack Lu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Junli of Taiyuan attacked Luzhou with twenty thousand.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申，幽州、雲州蕃、漢兵三萬攻雁門，太原將李存信、薛阿檀擊敗之。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen Youzhou and Yunzhou barbarian and Han troops thirty thousand attacked Yanmen; Taiyuan commanders Li Cunxin and Xue Atan defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen thirty thousand from You and Yun attacked Yanmen; Cunxin and Atan of Taiyuan defeated them.

sentences.zh: 汴將葛從周棄上党，康君立入據之，克用以君立為澤潞兵馬留後。

translations.literal: Bian commander Ge Congzhou abandoned Shangdang; Kang Junli entered and held it; Keyong made Junli acting Ze-Lu military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Congzhou abandoned Shangdang; Junli held it and Keyong made him acting Ze-Lu commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸丑朔，太原將邢州刺史李存孝自恃擒孫揆功，合為昭義帥，怨克用授康君立。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eleventh month, guichou, Taiyuan commander Xing Prefecture governor Li Cunxiao, relying on the merit of capturing Sun Kui, expected to be made Zhaoyi commander and resented Keyong's appointing Kang Junli.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month guichou new moon: Li Cunxiao of Xingzhou, proud of capturing Kui, wanted Zhaoyi and resented Junli's appointment.

sentences.zh: 存孝自晉州率行營兵歸邢州，據城上表歸朝，仍致書與張浚、王鎔求援。

translations.literal: Cunxiao led encampment troops from Jin Prefecture back to Xing Prefecture, held the city, submitted a memorial to the court, and still sent letters to Zhang Jun and Wang Rong seeking aid.
translations.idiomatic: Cunxiao returned to Xingzhou, held the city, submitted to court, and wrote Jun and Rong for aid.

sentences.zh: 克用遣大將李存信、薛阿檀拒王師于陰地，三戰三捷，由是河西鄜、夏、邠、岐之軍渡河西歸。

translations.literal: Keyong sent the great generals Li Cunxin and Xue Atan to resist the imperial army at Yindi; three battles, three victories; thereby the western circuits' armies of Bin, Xia, Bin, and Qi crossed west of the river and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Cunxin and Atan beat the imperial army three times at Yindi; Bin, Xia, Bin, and Qi troops crossed west and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 韓建以諸軍保平陽，存信追之，建軍又敗，建退保絳州。

translations.literal: Han Jian held the armies at Pingyang; Cunxin pursued; Jian's army was again defeated and Jian retreated to defend Jiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Han Jian held Pingyang; Cunxin routed him and Jian fled to Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 張浚以汴卒、禁軍萬人在晉州，存信攻之三日，相與謀曰：「張浚宰相，俘之無益，天子禁兵，不宜加害。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun had ten thousand Bian troops and imperial guard troops at Jin Prefecture; Cunxin attacked for three days; they deliberated, saying: "Zhang Jun is a chief minister—capturing him is no benefit; the Son of Heaven's guard troops must not be harmed.
translations.idiomatic: Jun had ten thousand Bian and guard troops at Jinzhou; after three days' attack they said, "Jun is a chief minister—no gain in taking him; do not harm the guard.

sentences.zh: 如得平陽，於我無利。

translations.literal: If we take Pingyang, it is no advantage to us."
translations.idiomatic: Taking Pingyang helps us nothing."

sentences.zh: 」遂退舍五十里而軍。

translations.literal: They thereupon withdrew and encamped fifty li away.
translations.idiomatic: They withdrew fifty li and camped.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬午朔，張浚、韓建拔晉、絳遁去，李存信收晉、絳，大掠河中四郡。

translations.literal: On the first day of the twelfth month, renwu, Zhang Jun and Han Jian abandoned Jin and Jiang and fled; Li Cunxin recovered Jin and Jiang and plundered greatly in the four commanderies of Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month renwu new moon: Jun and Jian fled; Cunxin took Jin and Jiang and ravaged Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，制特進、中書侍郎、平章事、太原四面行營都統張浚可檢校兵部尚書，兼鄂州刺史、御史大夫，充鄂嶽觀察使。

translations.literal: On bingyin an edict made Special Advancement, Vice Director of the Chancellery, Grand Councillor, overall commander of the encircling armies on four sides of Taiyuan Zhang Jun acting Minister of War, concurrent E Prefecture governor and Censor-in-Chief, and observer of E and Yue.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Jun was demoted to acting War Minister and E-Yue observer.

sentences.zh: 以開府儀同三司、守司徒、門下侍郎、同平章事、上柱國、魯國公、食邑三千戶、充諸道鹽鐵轉運等使孔緯檢校司徒，兼江陵尹、荊南節度觀察處置使。

translations.literal: Grand Preceptor of the Palace with the ceremonial of the Three Excellencies, acting Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Chancellery, Associate Grand Councillor, Supreme Pillar of State, Duke of Lu with a fief of three thousand households, commissioner of salt and iron transport for all circuits Kong Wei was made acting Minister of Works, concurrent Governor of Jiangling, and military commissioner and observer of Jingnan with disposition.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Wei was made acting Minister of Works and Jingnan commissioner at Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 庚午，新除鄂岳觀察使張浚責授連州刺史，新除荊南節度使孔緯責授均州刺史，並馳驛赴任。

translations.literal: On gengwu the newly appointed E-Yue observer Zhang Jun was demoted and appointed prefect of Lian, the newly appointed Jingnan military commissioner Kong Wei was demoted and appointed prefect of Jun—both were ordered to proceed post-haste to their posts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Jun was sent to Lian and Kong Wei to Jun, both ordered post-haste.

sentences.zh: 太原軍屯晉州，李克用遣中使韓歸範還朝，因上表訴冤，言：「被賊臣張浚依倚硃全忠離間功臣，致削奪臣官爵。

translations.literal: The Taiyuan army encamped at Jin Prefecture; Li Keyong sent the palace envoy Han Guifan back to court and thereby submitted a memorial pleading injustice, saying: "I was cut off from office and titles by the rebel minister Zhang Jun, who relied on Zhu Quanzhong to estrange meritorious ministers."
translations.idiomatic: Keyong sent Han Guifan to court pleading injustice: "Zhang Jun and Zhu Quanzhong estranged me and stripped my titles."

sentences.zh: 」朝廷欲令釋憾，下群臣議其可否。

translations.literal: The court wished to let him release resentment and sent the matter for ministers to deliberate whether it was permissible.
translations.idiomatic: The court sought reconciliation and asked ministers whether to restore him.

sentences.zh: 左僕射韋昭度等議曰：

translations.literal: Left Vice Director Wei Zhaodu and others argued:
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zhaodu, Left Vice Director, and others argued:

sentences.zh: 「賞功罰否，前聖之令猷；

translations.literal: "Rewarding merit and punishing fault is the former sage's constant plan;
translations.idiomatic: "Reward merit, punish fault—that is the sage's plan;

sentences.zh: 含垢匿瑕，百王之垂訓。

translations.literal: bearing grime and hiding flaws is the hundred kings' enduring instruction."
translations.idiomatic: bearing flaws is the hundred kings' teaching."

sentences.zh: 是以雷解而羲文象德，網開而湯化歸仁，用彼懷柔，式存彝範。

translations.literal: Therefore when Lei was released Xi wrote the image of virtue, and when the net was opened Tang's transforming benevolence returned—using such gentle compliance preserves the constant model.
translations.idiomatic: When Lei was freed Xi wrote virtue; when the net opened Tang's mercy returned—gentleness preserves the model.

sentences.zh: 上自軒農之代，下臻文武之朝，罔不允洽寬弘，以流霈澤。

translations.literal: From the age of Xuanyuan down to the reigns of Wen and Wu, none failed to be broadly harmonious and generous, pouring forth favor like rain.
translations.idiomatic: From Xuanyuan to Wen and Wu, rulers poured favor like rain.

sentences.zh: 況國家德祖守成之日，憲宗致理之時，車軌一同，桑麻萬里。

translations.literal: Moreover in the time when Dezong guarded the inheritance and Xianzong brought order, carriage tracks were one and mulberry and hemp stretched ten thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: Under Dezong and Xianzong the realm was one track and ten thousand li of hemp.

sentences.zh: 燭龍外野，悉在梯航；

translations.literal: Beyond the Candle Dragon's wilds, all came by ladder and boat;
translations.idiomatic: Far lands came by sea and road;

sentences.zh: 火鼠窮郊，鹹歸正朔。

translations.literal: in the Fire Rat's remotest borderlands, all returned to the true calendar."
translations.idiomatic: the remotest borders returned to Tang's calendar."

sentences.zh: 然猶王承宗擁兵鎮、冀，詔範希朝討之，仍歲無功，卒行赦宥。

translations.literal: Yet Wang Chengzong still held troops in Zhen and Ji; the edict sent Fan Xichao to attack him—year after year without success, and in the end amnesty was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Chengzong held Zhen-Ji until amnesty ended years of failed attacks.

sentences.zh: 而又硃滔以幽州之眾，結田悅、李納、王武俊之強，遣馬燧等征之不克，旋又寬之。

translations.literal: And Zhu Tao with Youzhou's hosts joined Tian Yue, Li Na, and Wang Wujun in strength; Ma Sui and others campaigned without overcoming them, and soon they too were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Tao, Tian Yue, Li Na, and Wang Wujun were pardoned after Ma Sui failed to crush them.

sentences.zh: 以累聖之典謀睿哲，大朝之紀律文明，非不欲厲彼風驅，快其電掃。

translations.literal: With the accumulated sages' plans and the great court's civilized discipline, it was not that they did not wish to drive the wind and sweep with lightning.
translations.idiomatic: Sage policy and civilized discipline did not lack will to strike like wind and lightning.

sentences.zh: 然且考《春秋》之義，稽楚、鄭之文，或退而許平，或服而更舍，存于舊史，載彼新書。

translations.literal: Yet they examined the meaning of the Spring and Autumn Annals and weighed the documents of Chu and Zheng—sometimes retreating and granting peace, sometimes submitting and again releasing—preserved in the old histories and recorded in the new books."
translations.idiomatic: Yet they read Spring and Autumn and Chu-Zheng texts—sometimes peace, sometimes pardon—preserved in history."

sentences.zh: 李克用代漠強宗，陰山貴胤，呼吸而風雲作氣，指麾而草樹成形。

translations.literal: Li Keyong is a strong clan of the desert, noble scion of the Yin Mountains; at a breath wind and cloud rise, at a gesture grass and trees take form.
translations.idiomatic: Keyong is a desert strong clan, Yin Mountain nobility—wind and cloud at a breath.

sentences.zh: 仰天指心，誓獻失訾之首；

translations.literal: He pointed to Heaven and his heart, vowing to present the head of the lost Zi;
translations.idiomatic: He swore to Heaven to bring the rebel Zi's head;

sentences.zh: 伏弢歐血，屢親都護之營。

translations.literal: he lay by his bow and tasted blood, repeatedly visiting the protector-general's camp."
translations.idiomatic: he lay by his bow and repeatedly came to the protector's camp."

sentences.zh: 所謂勇多上人，自匪窮來歸我。

translations.literal: What is called courage that surpasses others—he himself did not come to us in extremity.
translations.idiomatic: His courage surpassed others—yet he did not come to us only in ruin.

sentences.zh: 及陛下聖考懿宗皇帝之朝，彭門失守，親驅銳卒，首建殊功。

translations.literal: In the reign of Your Majesty's late father Emperor Yizong, when Peng Gate was lost he personally drove crack troops and first established outstanding merit.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yizong, when Peng Gate fell he led crack troops and won first merit.

sentences.zh: 而先帝即位之初，渚宮大擾，復提義旅，克靜妖氛。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the late emperor's accession, when Zhugong was greatly disturbed, he again raised righteous troops and quelled the evil miasma.
translations.idiomatic: At Xizong's accession he again raised troops and quelled Zhugong's turmoil.

sentences.zh: 其後封豕長蛇，薦食上國，繼以子朝之亂，皆因重耳之盟，保大朝之宗祧，垂中興于簡冊。

translations.literal: Afterward the great boar and long snake devoured the upper realm in succession; because of the chaos of the Zi reign it all stemmed from Chong'er's covenant—preserving the great dynasty's ancestral temple and bequeathing restoration to the annals."
translations.idiomatic: Later rebels devoured the realm; through Chong'er's covenant he preserved the ancestral temple and restoration."

sentences.zh: 蓋聖王之禦天下也，有勳可書，有績可載，宥過不忘於十代，念功豈止于一時。

translations.literal: In general when a sage king rules all under Heaven, merit may be written and achievement recorded; pardoning faults is not forgotten for ten generations, and remembering merit does not stop at one season.
translations.idiomatic: Sage kings write merit and remember it beyond one season—pardon outlasts ten generations.

sentences.zh: 天高聽卑，請事斯語。

translations.literal: Heaven is high and hears the low—please act on these words."
translations.idiomatic: Heaven hears the low—please heed this."

sentences.zh: 且四海之內，創磐猶殷，九貢之邦，綱條未理。

translations.literal: Moreover within the four seas creation is still fresh and suffering deep; of the nine tribute regions the net of rule is not yet ordered.
translations.idiomatic: The realm still bleeds; the nine regions are not yet ordered.

sentences.zh: 昨者遽起邠、岐之眾，尋已退還；

translations.literal: Yesterday Bin and Qi troops were suddenly raised and soon withdrew;
translations.idiomatic: Bin and Qi troops were raised and soon withdrew;

sentences.zh: 又征燕、薊之師，倏聞內變。

translations.literal: again Yan and Ji armies were levied and suddenly inner turmoil was heard."
translations.idiomatic: Yan and Ji armies were levied and inner turmoil followed."

sentences.zh: 出於饟饋失職，資扉絕供，致此投戈，是乖借箸。

translations.literal: It arose from failure in rations and closing of supply gates, causing them to cast aside weapons—this was contrary to the plan of borrowing chopsticks.
translations.idiomatic: Rations failed and gates closed—troops cast aside arms, contrary to wise counsel.

sentences.zh: 蓋下計之未熟，非聖謀之不臧。

translations.literal: It was that lower plans were not mature, not that the sage strategy was wrong."
translations.idiomatic: Plans below were immature, not the sage strategy."

sentences.zh: 儻宸斷重離，天機間出，錄茲成款，散彼師徒，虛其念舊之懷，待以如初之禮。

translations.literal: If Your Sagely Resolve were again set apart and Heaven's opportunity briefly appeared, record this sincere pledge, disperse those troops, empty the thought of remembering old grievances, and treat him with ceremony as at first.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty records his pledge, disperses troops, and treats him as before,

sentences.zh: 臣等所議，實以在斯。

translations.literal: what your subjects discuss is truly here."
translations.idiomatic: that is what we urge."

sentences.zh: 抑又聞往者漢將趙充國欲因邊境衰弱，出兵擊之，於是魏相上書，畫陳利害，且曰：『恃國家之大，矜人物之眾，欲見威於敵者，謂之驕兵。

translations.literal: Moreover we have heard that in former times Han general Zhao Chongguo wished to exploit border weakness and send troops to strike; thereupon Wei Xiang submitted a memorial, setting forth benefit and harm, and said: 'Relying on the state's greatness and boasting of men's multitude, wishing to show might to the enemy is called arrogant troops.
translations.idiomatic: We recall Zhao Chongguo wished to strike a weak border; Wei Xiang wrote that troops arrogant of the state's size are doomed—

sentences.zh: 兵驕者滅，非但人事，乃天道也。

translations.literal: Arrogant troops are destroyed—this is not only human affairs but Heaven's way.'"
translations.idiomatic: arrogant troops perish by Heaven's way.'"

sentences.zh: 』又曰：『臣不知此兵何名者也。

translations.literal: He also said: 'Your subject does not know what name this army bears.'"
translations.idiomatic: He said, 'I do not know this army's name.'"

sentences.zh: 』兵出無名，事乃不成，漢宣納之，竟罷其伐。

translations.literal: Troops without a name do not succeed in the affair; Emperor Xuan accepted it and in the end halted the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Armies without righteous name fail; Xuan accepted and halted the campaign.

sentences.zh: 伏惟皇帝陛下鑒往古用師之難，采列聖遷善之美，恩加區宇，信及豚魚，則臣等不勝懇願。

translations.literal: We humbly consider that Your Majesty should mirror the difficulty of using troops in former antiquity and adopt the beauty of the successive sages in shifting to good; grace extending to the realm and trust reaching even pigs and fish—then your subjects cannot express their earnest wish.
translations.idiomatic: Mirror antiquity's difficulty of war and the sages' turn to mercy—then we are answered.

sentences.zh: 況今汴、魏猶艱，幽、定方困，縱遣之調發，豈能集事！

translations.literal: Moreover now Bian and Wei are still hard pressed and You and Ding are in distress; even if levies were sent, how could affairs be gathered!
translations.idiomatic: Bian and Wei are hard pressed; levies cannot gather armies now.

sentences.zh: 虛行號令，徒召寇讎，將以剿人，非唯辱國。

translations.literal: Emptyly issuing orders only summons enemies; wishing to destroy men is not only to shame the state.
translations.idiomatic: Empty orders summon enemies and shame the state.

sentences.zh: 且黠斯舉勤王之眾，推效命之誠，未能虜騎獨攻，所望漢兵同力。

translations.literal: Moreover the crafty tribes raised troops in loyalty to the throne and offered the sincerity of devoted service, yet could not alone attack the barbarian horsemen—they hoped Han troops would share the strength.
translations.idiomatic: Loyal tribes offered service yet could not fight alone—they needed Han strength.

sentences.zh: 令茲數鎮，奔命不遑，難致濟師，恐又生事。

translations.literal: Now these several circuits rush orders without leisure; it is hard to bring relieving armies and we fear new trouble.
translations.idiomatic: Circuits rush orders; relief is hard and new trouble feared.

sentences.zh: 諭其漸當暑熱，非利戎旃，悉力頒沾，遣還蕃部。

translations.literal: Advise them that as summer heat gradually comes it is not advantageous for military banners; distribute favors fully and send them back to their border tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Tell them summer heat ill suits war; pay them and send them home.

sentences.zh: 重盈陳五郡之卒，益謹關防；

translations.literal: Chong Ying arrays the troops of five commanderies and tightens the passes more strictly;
translations.idiomatic: Chong Ying holds five commanderies and tightens the passes;

sentences.zh: 王珙振兩河之雄，更嚴旗鼓。

translations.literal: Wang Gong rouses the heroes of the two Hebei and makes drums and banners sterner."
translations.idiomatic: Wang Gong stirs two Hebei and sharpens the host."

sentences.zh: 然後獎其上表，哀以自陳，錄彼前勞，責之後效。

translations.literal: Then reward his submitted memorial, pity his self-statement, record his former merit, and charge his later effectiveness.
translations.idiomatic: Then reward his memorial, record old merit, and charge new service.

sentences.zh: 征神爵之往典，還日逐之故封。

translations.literal: Invoke the past canon of divine valor and restore the old fief of the Riyue."
translations.idiomatic: Invoke divine valor's canon and restore old fiefs."

sentences.zh: 諭其已斥王恭，不使更疑晉帝，凡百臣子，實切乃誠。

translations.literal: Advise him that Wang Gong has already been expelled and he should no longer doubt the Jin emperor; all hundred ministers are truly earnest in this."
translations.idiomatic: Tell him Wang Gong is gone and he need not doubt the throne—all ministers urge this."

sentences.zh: 其克用在身官爵，並請卻還，仍依前編入屬籍。

translations.literal: As for Keyong's personal offices and titles, all are asked to be returned, and he is still entered in the lineage register as before."
translations.idiomatic: Restore Keyong's titles and register him as before."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The edict was assented to.
translations.idiomatic: The court assented.

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士承旨、兵部侍郎崔昭緯本官同平章事，御史中丞徐彥若為戶部侍郎、同平章事。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of War Cui Zhaowei was confirmed in office as Associate Grand Councillor; Censor-in-Chief Xu Yanruo was made Vice Minister of Revenue and Associate Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Zhaowei became Associate Grand Councillor; Xu Yanruo became Revenue vice minister and associate councillor.

sentences.zh: 尚書右僕射王徽卒，贈司空，諡曰貞。

translations.literal: Right Vice Director of the Secretariat Wang Hui died; he was posthumously made Minister of Works with posthumous title Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Hui, Right Vice Director, died; posthumous Minister of Works, title Zhen.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月壬子朔，李克用急攻邢州。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dashun, spring, first month, on the day renzi the new moon, Li Keyong pressed the attack on Xing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Dashun 2, spring, first month renzi new moon: Keyong pressed Xingzhou.

sentences.zh: 李存考求援于王鎔，鎔出軍援之，屯於堯山。

translations.literal: Li Cunxiao sought aid from Wang Rong; Rong sent troops to rescue him and encamped at Yaoshan.
translations.idiomatic: Cunxiao called Wang Rong; Rong camped at Yaoshan to rescue him.

sentences.zh: 克用自太原至，擊敗之，進圍邢州。

translations.literal: Keyong came from Taiyuan, defeated him, and advanced to besiege Xing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Keyong came from Taiyuan, routed Rong, and besieged Xingzhou.

sentences.zh: 司徒、門下侍郎、平章事杜讓能進位太尉、太清宮使、弘文館大學士、延資庫使領諸道鹽鐵轉運等使。

translations.literal: Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Chancellery, and Grand Councillor Du Rangneng was advanced to Grand Commandant, Commissioner of the Grand Pure Palace, University Fellow of the Hongwen Institute, Commissioner of the Extended Resources Store, and commissioner of salt and iron transport for all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Du Rangneng was advanced to Grand Commandant with Grand Pure Palace and salt transport.

sentences.zh: 以中書侍郎、吏部尚書、平章事劉望為門下侍郎、監修國史、判度支事，工部侍郎、平章事崔昭緯判戶部事。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Chancellery, Minister of Personnel, and Grand Councillor Liu Chongwang was made Vice Director of the Chancellery, supervised the national history, and judged Revenue affairs; Vice Minister of Works and Grand Councillor Cui Zhaowei judged Revenue affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Chongwang took Chancellery vice director with history and Revenue; Cui Zhaowei judged Revenue.

sentences.zh: 二月辛巳，李克用復檢校太師、中書令、太原尹、北都留守、河東節度觀察處置等使。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi Li Keyong was again made acting Grand Preceptor, Director of the Secretariat, Governor of Taiyuan, Northern Capital regent, and military commissioner and observer of Hedong with disposition.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Keyong was restored Grand Preceptor, Secretariat Director, and Hedong commissioner.

sentences.zh: 時張浚、韓建兵敗後，為太原將李存信等所追，至是方自含山逾王偓，出河清，達于河陽。

translations.literal: At the time Zhang Jun and Han Jian, after their armies were defeated, were pursued by Taiyuan commanders Li Cunxin and others; only now did they cross from Hanshan over Wang Wo, emerge at Heqing, reach Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: Jun and Jian, beaten and pursued by Cunxin, crossed Hanshan and Wang Wo to Heyang.

sentences.zh: 屬河溢，無舟楫，建壞人盧舍，為木罌數百，方獲渡，人多覆溺，休其徒于司徒廟。

translations.literal: The river was in flood and there were no boats; Jian destroyed people's houses to make several hundred wooden rafts before they could cross; many were overturned and drowned; they rested their troops at the Minister of Works Temple.
translations.idiomatic: The river was flooded without boats; Jian tore down houses for hundreds of rafts; many drowned crossing; they rested at the Works Minister's temple.

sentences.zh: 是役也，朝廷倚朱全忠及三鎮兵。

translations.literal: In this campaign the court relied on Zhu Quanzhong and the troops of the three circuits.
translations.idiomatic: The court had relied on Quanzhong and the three circuits.

sentences.zh: 全忠方連兵徐鄆，乃求兵糧于鎮、魏，全忠終不至行營。

translations.literal: Quanzhong was then continuously campaigning in Xu and Yun and sought troops and grain from Zhen and Wei; Quanzhong in the end never reached the encampment.
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhong fought in Xu-Yun and demanded supplies from Zhen and Wei but never reached camp.

sentences.zh: 鎮、魏倚太原為扞蔽，如破太原郡，恐危鎮、魏，王鎔、羅弘信亦不出師。

translations.literal: Zhen and Wei relied on Taiyuan as a shield; if Taiyuan prefecture were broken, Zhen and Wei would be endangered—Wang Rong and Luo Hongxin also did not send troops.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen and Wei hid behind Taiyuan; Rong and Hongxin would not march.

sentences.zh: 唯邠、岐、華、鄜、夏烏合之眾會晉州。

translations.literal: Only the mixed hosts of Bin, Qi, Hua, Bin, and Xia assembled at Jin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Only Bin, Qi, Hua, Bin, and Xia hosts met at Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 兵未交而孫揆擒，燕卒敗，所以河西、岐下之師望風潰散，而浚、建至敗。

translations.literal: Before battle Sun Kui was captured and the Yan troops defeated; therefore the western and Qi troops scattered at the wind, and Jun and Jian reached defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Kui was taken before battle; western and Qi troops fled; Jun and Jian were ruined.

sentences.zh: 全忠以鎮、魏不助兵糧觀望，遣龐師古將兵討魏，陷十縣，羅弘信乞盟，乃退。

translations.literal: Quanzhong, because Zhen and Wei would not aid with troops and grain and stood watching, sent Pang Shigu to campaign against Wei and took ten counties; Luo Hongxin begged alliance and he withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhong sent Pang Shigu against Wei for ten counties until Hongxin sued for peace.

sentences.zh: 棣州刺史張蟾為青州將王師範所敗。

translations.literal: Di Prefecture governor Zhang Chan was defeated by Qing commander Wang Shifan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Chan of Di was beaten by Wang Shifan of Qing.

sentences.zh: 新授平盧節度使崔安潛自棣州歸朝，復授太子少師。

translations.literal: The newly appointed Pinglu military commissioner Cui Anqian returned to court from Di Prefecture and was again appointed Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: New Pinglu commissioner Cui Anqian returned from Di and became Junior Tutor again.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥朔，以青州權知兵馬留後王師範檢校兵部尚書，兼青州刺史、御史大夫，充平盧軍。

translations.literal: On the first day of the third month, xinhai, Wang Shifan, acting Qing military commissioner, was made acting Minister of War, concurrent Qing prefect and Censor-in-Chief, and commissioner of the Pinglu Army.
translations.idiomatic: Third month xinhai new moon: Wang Shifan was made acting War Minister and Pinglu commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥朔，以青州權知兵馬留後王師節度觀察、押新羅渤海兩蕃等使。

translations.literal: On the first day of the third month, xinhai, military commissioner and observer of Pinglu, commissioner over the two foreign states Silla and Parhae.
translations.idiomatic: He was also made observer of Pinglu with charge over Silla and Parhae.

sentences.zh: 淮南節度孫儒為宣州觀察使楊行密所殺。

translations.literal: Huainan military commissioner Sun Ru was killed by Xuan observer Yang Xingmi.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Ru of Huainan was killed by Yang Xingmi of Xuan.

sentences.zh: 初，行密揚州失守，據宣州，孫儒以兵攻圍三年。

translations.literal: Earlier Xingmi lost Yangzhou and held Xuan Prefecture; Sun Ru besieged him with troops for three years.
translations.idiomatic: Xingmi had lost Yangzhou and held Xuanzhou under Sun Ru's three-year siege.

sentences.zh: 是春，淮南大饑，軍中疫癘死者十三四。

translations.literal: That spring Huainan suffered great famine; in the army thirteen or fourteen in ten died of pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: That spring famine and plague killed thirteen in ten of Sun Ru's army.

sentences.zh: 是月，孫儒亦病，為帳下所執，降行密。

translations.literal: That month Sun Ru also fell ill, was seized by his tent guards, and surrendered to Xingmi.
translations.idiomatic: That month guards seized the sick Sun Ru and surrendered him to Xingmi.

sentences.zh: 行密乃並孫儒之眾，復據廣陵。

translations.literal: Xingmi thereupon merged Sun Ru's host and again held Guangling.
translations.idiomatic: Xingmi took Sun Ru's troops and again held Guangling.

sentences.zh: 六月，王鎔出軍援李存孝，克用大舉討鎮州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Wang Rong sent troops to aid Li Cunxiao; Keyong raised a great campaign against Zhen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: Rong aided Cunxiao; Keyong marched on Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 七月，太原軍出井陘，屯於常山鎮，大掠鎮、趙、深諸郡。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the Taiyuan army came out through Jingxing Pass and encamped at Changshan town, plundering greatly in Zhen, Zhao, and Shen commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Taiyuan came through Jingxing and ravaged Zhen, Zhao, and Shen.

sentences.zh: 幽州節度使李匡威自率步騎三萬援王鎔。

translations.literal: You military commissioner Li Kuangwei personally led thirty thousand foot and horse to aid Wang Rong.
translations.idiomatic: Li Kuangwei of You led thirty thousand to aid Rong.

sentences.zh: 八月，克用班師。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Keyong withdrew his army.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: Keyong withdrew.

sentences.zh: 九月丁未朔。

translations.literal: On the first day of the ninth month, dingwei, the new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month opened on dingwei.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，天子賜左軍中尉楊復恭几杖，以大將軍致仕。

translations.literal: On yimao the Son of Heaven bestowed on Left Army Commander Yang Fugong a staff and armrest, with retirement as Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the emperor gave Yang Fugong staff and armrest and retired him as Grand General.

sentences.zh: 復恭怒，稱病不受詔。

translations.literal: Fugong was enraged, claimed illness, and would not accept the edict.
translations.idiomatic: Fugong raged, feigned illness, and refused the edict.

sentences.zh: 十月丁丑朔。

translations.literal: On the first day of the tenth month, dingchou, the new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month opened on dingchou.

sentences.zh: 甲申，天威軍使李順節率禁兵討楊復恭，復恭假子玉山軍使楊守信以兵拒之，列陣於昌化裏。

translations.literal: On jiashen Tianwei Army commander Li Shunjie led guard troops to attack Yang Fugong; Fugong's adopted son Yushan Army commander Yang Shouxin resisted with troops and drew up formation in Changhua Ward.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Li Shunjie attacked Yang Fugong; adopted son Yang Shouxin blocked him at Changhua Ward.

sentences.zh: 昭宗登延喜樓，陳兵自衛以俟變。

translations.literal: Zhaozong ascended Yanxi Tower, arrayed troops to guard himself, and waited for the turn of events.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaozong mounted Yanxi Tower with guards and waited.

sentences.zh: 相持至晚，不戰而退。

translations.literal: They faced each other until evening without battle and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: They faced off until evening and withdrew without fighting.

sentences.zh: 是夜，守信乃擁其眾衛復恭出京師，且戰且行，出通化門，由七盤路之商州，又令義兒張綰為後殿。

translations.literal: That night Shouxin then escorted Fugong's host out of the capital, fighting as they went, out through Tonghua Gate, by the Seven Turns road to Shang Prefecture, and ordered his sworn son Zhang Wan as rearguard.
translations.idiomatic: That night Shouxin fought out through Tonghua Gate toward Shangzhou with Zhang Wan as rearguard.

sentences.zh: 永安都頭安權追及綰，擒之而還。

translations.literal: Yong'an company head An Quan overtook Wan, seized him, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: An Quan of Yong'an overtook Wan and captured him.

sentences.zh: 十一月，朱全忠上表，請移時溥節鎮。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Zhu Quanzhong submitted a memorial asking to transfer Shi Pu's commission.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: Quanzhong asked to move Shi Pu's commission.

sentences.zh: 是月，汴軍陷宿州，乃授溥太子太師。

translations.literal: That month Bian troops took Suzhou; Pu was then appointed Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: That month Bian took Suzhou; Pu was made Junior Tutor.

sentences.zh: 溥將劉知俊降汴軍。

translations.literal: Pu's commander Liu Zhijun surrendered to Bian troops.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhijun of Pu's army surrendered to Bian.

sentences.zh: 鎮州王鎔、幽州李匡威復謀攻定州以分其地，王處存求援於太原。

translations.literal: Zhen commander Wang Rong and You commander Li Kuangwei again plotted to attack Ding Prefecture to divide its territory; Wang Chuncun sought aid from Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Rong and Kuangwei plotted against Dingzhou; Chuncun called Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙子朔，以光祿大夫、門下侍郎、右僕射、平章事、監修國史、判度支、上柱國、彭城縣開國男劉崇望檢校司空、同平章事，兼徐州刺史，充武寧軍節度、徐宿觀察制置使。

translations.literal: On the first day of the twelfth month, bingzi, Liu Chongwang was made acting Minister of Works and Associate Grand Councillor, concurrent Xu prefect, and military commissioner of Wuning with Xu-Su observation and disposition.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month bingzi new moon: Liu Chongwang was made Works minister and Wuning commissioner at Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 時李順節恃恩恣橫，出入以兵仗自隨，兩軍中尉劉景宣、西門君遂懼其窺圖非望。

translations.literal: At the time Li Shunjie relied on favor and acted lawlessly, going out and in with armed followers; the two army commandants Liu Jingxuan and Ximen Junsui feared he coveted unrightful ambition.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shunjie swaggered with armed guards; Liu Jingxuan and Ximen Junsui feared his ambition.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，兩中尉傳詔召順節，順節以甲士三百自隨，至銀台門，門司傳詔止從者。

translations.literal: On dinghai the two commandants transmitted an edict summoning Shunjie; Shunjie came with three hundred armored soldiers to Yintai Gate; the gate office transmitted the edict stopping attendants.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai both commandants summoned Shunjie; he came with three hundred guards to Yintai Gate.

sentences.zh: 兩中尉在仗舍邀順節，坐次，令部將嗣光審斫順節，頭隨劍落。

translations.literal: The two commandants waited for Shunjie in the guards' lodge, and when he sat down ordered their officer Si Guangshan to cut him down—his head fell with the sword.
translations.idiomatic: In the guards' lodge Si Guangshan beheaded Shunjie at the commandants' order.

sentences.zh: 其部下知順節死，大噪出延喜門。

translations.literal: His subordinates, learning Shunjie was dead, clamored greatly and rushed out through Yanxi Gate.
translations.idiomatic: His men learned he was dead and rioted out Yanxi Gate.

sentences.zh: 是日，天威、捧日、登封三都亂，剽永寧裏，至晚方定。

translations.literal: That day Tianwei, Puri, and Dengfeng three companies mutinied and plundered Yongning Ward; only by evening was it settled.
translations.idiomatic: That day three guard companies plundered Yongning until evening.

sentences.zh: 戶部尚書鄭延昌為中書侍郎、平章事、判度支。

translations.literal: Minister of Revenue Zheng Yanchang was made Vice Director of the Chancellery, Grand Councillor, and judged Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Yanchang of Revenue became Vice Director and Grand Councillor with Revenue.

sentences.zh: 三月，克用、處存斂軍而退。

translations.literal: In the third month Keyong and Chuncun gathered troops and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: Keyong and Chuncun withdrew.

sentences.zh: 四月乙亥，左軍中尉西門君遂殺天威軍使賈德晟，時德晟與李順節俱掌天威軍，順節死，中尉惡德晟，誣奏殺之。

translations.literal: On the day yihai Left Army Commander Ximen Junsui killed Tianwei Army commander Jia Desheng; at the time Desheng and Li Shunjie together controlled the Tianwei Army—when Shunjie died the commandants hated Desheng and memorialized falsely to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Ximen Junsui killed Jia Desheng, co-commander of Tianwei after Shunjie's death.

sentences.zh: 是日，德晟部下千余騎出奔鳳翔，自是岐軍益盛。

translations.literal: That day more than a thousand of Desheng's cavalry fled out to Fengxiang; from then on Qi troops grew stronger.
translations.idiomatic: That day a thousand of Desheng's horse fled to Fengxiang and Qi grew stronger.

sentences.zh: 五月甲辰，制以河南尹張全義檢校司徒、同平章事，兼孟州刺史，充河陽三城節度、孟懷澤觀察等使。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen an edict made Henan Intendant Zhang Quanyi acting Minister of Works and Associate Grand Councillor, concurrent Meng prefect, and military commissioner of Heyang Three Cities with Meng-Huai-Ze observation.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Zhang Quanyi was made Works minister and Heyang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 七月，燕、趙之卒合勢援邢州，太原大將李存信率軍拒於堯山，王鎔大敗而還。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Yan and Zhao troops combined to aid Xing Prefecture; Taiyuan great general Li Cunxin led troops to resist at Yaoshan; Wang Rong was greatly defeated and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Yan-Zhao aided Xingzhou; Cunxin routed Rong at Yaoshan.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛丑，鳳翔、邠寧之眾攻興元府，陷之。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou Fengxiang and Binning hosts attacked Xingyuan prefecture and took it.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Fengxiang and Binning took Xingyuan.

sentences.zh: 山南西道節度使楊守亮與前左軍中尉楊復恭、判官李巨川突圍而遁，將奔太原。

translations.literal: Jiannan West military commissioner Yang Shouliang together with former Left Army Commander Yang Fugong and aide Li Juchuan broke the encirclement and fled, intending to flee to Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Shouliang, Fugong, and Li Juchuan broke out toward Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 李茂貞表其子繼密權知興元府事。

translations.literal: Li Maozhen memorialized that his son Jimi should act as temporary Xingyuan prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Maozhen made his son Jimi acting Xingyuan governor.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未朔，華州節度使韓建奏於乾元縣遇興元潰散兵士，擊敗之。
