sentences.zh: 五月乙亥朔，以國子博士硃朴為右諫議大夫、同平章事。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on yihai, the first day, National University Erudite Zhu Pu was made Right Remonstrance Official and Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, yihai new moon: erudite Zhu Pu became right remonstrance official and grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 七月甲戌，帝與學士、親王登齊雲樓，西望長安，令樂工唱禦制《菩薩蠻》詞，奏畢，皆泣下沾襟，覃王已下並有屬和。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the emperor with academicians and imperial princes ascended Qiyun Tower, gazed west toward Chang'an, and ordered musicians to sing his composed "Bodhisattva Barbarian" lyrics; when the performance ended all wept soaking their robes; Princes of Tan and below each harmonized.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the emperor, scholars, and princes climbed Qiyun Tower, gazed at Chang'an, and had musicians sing his "Bodhisattva Barbarian"; all wept; princes harmonized.

sentences.zh: 八月甲辰朔，以工部尚書陸扆為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jiachen, the first day, Minister of Works Lu Yi was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jiachen new moon: Lu Yi became minister of war.

sentences.zh: 韓建與邠、岐三鎮素有無君之跡，及李克用誅行瑜，心常切齒。

translations.literal: Han Jian and the three Bin and Qi commands had long shown signs of disloyalty to the ruler; when Li Keyong executed Xingyu, he gnashed his teeth in heart.
translations.idiomatic: Han Jian and Bin-Qi commands had long shown disloyalty; when Keyong killed Xingyu, he gnashed his teeth.

sentences.zh: 去歲車駕將幸河東，乃令延王戒丕使太原，見克用，陳省方之意。

translations.literal: Last year when the carriage was to visit Hedong, he sent Prince of Yan Jiepi as envoy to Taiyuan to see Keyong and explain the plan to tour the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Last year, bound for Hedong, he sent Prince of Yan Jiepi to Taiyuan to explain touring the realm.

sentences.zh: 是月，延王自太原還。

translations.literal: That month the Prince of Yan returned from Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Yan returned from Taiyuan that month.

sentences.zh: 韓建奏曰：「自陛下即位已來，與近輔交惡，皆因諸王典兵，凶徒樂禍，遂致輿駕不安。

translations.literal: Han Jian memorialized: "Since Your Majesty's accession, strife with near supporters has all been because princes held troops; villains rejoiced in disaster, and the carriage grew unsafe.
translations.idiomatic: Han Jian wrote: "Since Your accession, strife with near supporters came from princes commanding troops; villains rejoiced and the carriage grew unsafe.

sentences.zh: 比者臣奏罷兵權，實慮有不測之變。

translations.literal: Recently I memorialized to end military power, truly fearing unforeseen change.
translations.idiomatic: I recently asked to end princes' military power, fearing unforeseen change.

sentences.zh: 今聞延王、覃王尚苞陰計，願陛下宸斷不疑，制於未亂，即社稷之福也。

translations.literal: Now I hear Princes of Yan and Tan still harbor secret designs; I beg Your Majesty decide without doubt and control disorder before it forms—that is fortune for the altars."
translations.idiomatic: Now I hear Princes of Yan and Tan still plot; decide without doubt before disorder forms—that is the altars' fortune."

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「豈至是耶！

translations.literal: The emperor said: "How could it come to that!"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Surely not!"

sentences.zh: 」居數日，以上無報，乃與知樞密劉季述矯制發兵，圍十六宅。

translations.literal: " After several days without response from above, he and Commissioner of Military Affairs Liu Jishu forged an edict to raise troops and besiege the Sixteen Mansions.
translations.idiomatic: After days without response he and Liu Jishu forged an edict, raised troops, and besieged the Sixteen Mansions.

sentences.zh: 諸王懼，披發沿垣而呼曰：「官家救兒命！

translations.literal: The princes were afraid, let down their hair, climbed the wall crying: "Imperial Father, save your sons' lives!"
translations.idiomatic: Princes let down their hair and cried along the wall: "Imperial Father, save us!"

sentences.zh: 或登屋沿樹。

translations.literal: Some climbed roofs and trees.
translations.idiomatic: Some fled onto roofs and trees.

sentences.zh: 是日，通王、覃王已下十一王並其侍者，皆為建兵所擁，至石堤穀，無長少皆殺之，而建以謀逆聞。

translations.literal: That day Princes of Tong, Tan, and eleven below with their attendants were seized by Jian's troops, taken to Shidi Valley, and all killed regardless of age; Jian reported it as treason.
translations.idiomatic: That day eleven princes and attendants were seized, taken to Shidi Valley, and all killed; Jian called it treason.

sentences.zh: 尋殺太子詹事馬道殷、將作監許岩士，貶平章事硃樸，皆上所寵昵者。

translations.literal: Soon Crown Prince Steward Ma Daoyin and Director of Palace Construction Xu Yanshi were killed; Grand Councilor Zhu Pu was demoted—all favorites of the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Ma Daoyin and Xu Yanshi were killed; Zhu Pu was demoted—all imperial favorites.

sentences.zh: 九月癸酉朔，以御史中丞狄歸昌為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on guiyou, the first day, Vice Censor-in-Chief Di Guichang was made Right Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, guiyou new moon: Di Guichang became right assistant director.

sentences.zh: 以刑部侍郎楊涉為吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Justice Yang She was made Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Yang She became vice minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 制以鎮海軍節度使錢鏐為鎮海軍節度、漸江東西道觀察處置等使、杭州越州刺史、上柱國、吳王。

translations.literal: An edict made Zhenhai Military Commissioner Qian Liu commissioner of Zhenhai, Commissioner of Zhe East and West Circuits, Prefect of Hangzhou and Yuezhou, Supreme Pillar, and King of Wu.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Qian Liu King of Wu, Zhenhai commissioner, and Zhe East-West commissioner.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸卯朔，以華州節度使韓建兼同州刺史、匡國軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on guimao, the first day, Huazhou Commissioner Han Jian was also made Prefect of Tongzhou and Commissioner of Kuangguo Army.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, guimao new moon: Han Jian also became Tongzhou prefect and Kuangguo commissioner.

sentences.zh: 硃全忠遣其將權徐州兵馬留後龐師古、兗州留後葛從周率兗、鄆、曹、濮、徐、宿、滑等兵士七萬渡淮討楊行密。

translations.literal: Zhu Quanzhong sent his generals acting Xuzhou Commissioner Pang Shigu and Yanzhou Commissioner Ge Congzhou with seventy thousand troops from Yan, Yun, Cao, Pu, Xu, Su, and Hua to cross the Huai and attack Yang Xingmi.
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhong sent Pang Shigu and Ge Congzhou with seventy thousand troops across the Huai against Yang Xingmi.

sentences.zh: 制乙太中大夫、前御史中丞裴贄為禮部尚書、知貢舉。

translations.literal: An edict made Grand Master of Honor Pei Zan, former Vice Censor-in-Chief, Minister of Rites and Director of the Examinations.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Pei Zan minister of rites and director of examinations.

sentences.zh: 幽州節度使劉仁恭大敗沙陀于安塞，李克用單騎僅免。

translations.literal: Youzhou Commissioner Liu Rengong greatly defeated the Shatuo at Anse; Li Keyong escaped on a single horse.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Rengong of Youzhou crushed the Shatuo at Anse; Keyong escaped alone.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申朔。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renshen, the first day.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, renshen new moon.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，淮南大將硃瑾潛出舟師襲汴軍於清口，龐師古舉軍皆沒，師古被執。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Huainan Grand General Zhu Jin secretly sent a fleet to strike Bian troops at Qingkou; Pang Shigu's whole army was lost and Shigu captured.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Zhu Jin struck Bian troops at Qingkou; Pang Shigu's army was lost and he was captured.

sentences.zh: 進葛從周自霍丘渡淮，至濠州，聞師古敗，乃退軍，信宿至渒河，方渡而硃瑾至。

translations.literal: Advancing, Ge Congzhou crossed the Huai from Huoqiu to Haozhou; hearing of Shigu's defeat he withdrew; after one night he reached the Pi River and was mid-crossing when Zhu Jin arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Ge Congzhou crossed from Huoqiu; hearing Shigu's defeat he withdrew; at the Pi River mid-crossing Zhu Jin arrived.

sentences.zh: 是日殺傷溺死殆盡，還者不滿千人，唯牛存節一軍先渡獲免。

translations.literal: That day killed, wounded, and drowned were nearly all; returners numbered fewer than a thousand—only Niu Cunjie's corps had crossed first and escaped.
translations.idiomatic: That day nearly all were killed or drowned; fewer than a thousand returned—only Niu Cunjie's corps escaped.

sentences.zh: 比至潁州，大雪寒凍，死者十五六。

translations.literal: By Yingzhou, heavy snow and bitter cold killed five or six in ten.
translations.idiomatic: By Yingzhou snow and cold killed five or six in ten.

sentences.zh: 自古喪師之甚，無如此也。

translations.literal: Since antiquity no defeat of an army had been like this.
translations.idiomatic: Since antiquity no army had been so ruined.

sentences.zh: 由是行密據有江、淮之間。

translations.literal: Thereby Xingmi held the lands between the Yangtze and Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Thereby Xingmi held the Yangtze–Huai region.

sentences.zh: 以檢校司空、權知兗州兵馬事葛從周為兗州刺史，充泰甯軍節度使；

translations.literal: Acting Minister of Works Ge Congzhou, acting Yanzhou military affairs, was made Prefect of Yanzhou and Commissioner of Taining Army;
translations.idiomatic: Ge Congzhou was made Yanzhou prefect and Taining commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以潁州刺史王敬蕘檢校尚書左僕射、兼徐州刺史，充武甯軍節度使：從全忠奏也。

translations.literal: Yingzhou Prefect Wang Jingrao was made Acting Left Vice Director and concurrent Xuzhou Prefect, Commissioner of Wuning Army—following Quanzhong's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jingrao became acting left vice director and Wuning commissioner—per Quanzhong's memorial.

sentences.zh: 光化元年春正月辛未朔，車駕在華州。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guanghua, spring, the first month, on xinwei, the first day, the imperial carriage was at Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: Guanghua 1, spring, xinwei new moon: the carriage was at Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 以兵部侍郎崔遠為戶部侍郎、同平章事。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of War Cui Yuan was made Vice Minister of Revenue and Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yuan became vice minister of revenue and grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 諸道貢修宮闕錢，命京兆尹韓建入京城計度。

translations.literal: All circuits sent funds to repair the palaces; Jingzhao Magistrate Han Jian was ordered into the capital to survey.
translations.idiomatic: Circuits sent palace-repair funds; Han Jian was ordered into the capital to survey.

sentences.zh: 朱全忠遣判官韋震奏事，求兼領鄆州。

translations.literal: Zhu Quanzhong sent his judge Wei Zhen to memorialize, asking also to hold Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhong sent judge Wei Zhen to ask also to hold Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 時全忠軍敗之後，欲自大其權，以扼鄰籓之變。

translations.literal: At that time after Quanzhong's defeat he wished to magnify his power to check neighboring feudatories.
translations.idiomatic: After his defeat Quanzhong wished to magnify power to check neighbors.

sentences.zh: 幽州節度使劉仁恭恃安塞之捷，欲吞噬河朔，是月遣其子守文將兵襲滄州，節度使盧彥威棄城而循，守文遂據之，自稱留後。

translations.literal: Youzhou Commissioner Liu Rengong, relying on the Anse victory, wished to swallow Hebei; that month he sent his son Shouwen with troops to raid Cangzhou; Commissioner Lu Yanwei abandoned the city and fled; Shouwen held it and styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Rengong, bold after Anse, sent Shouwen to raid Cangzhou; Yanwei fled; Shouwen held it as acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 四月庚子，制淑妃何氏宜冊為皇后。

translations.literal: On the fourth month, gengzi, an edict: Shufei He should be invested empress.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, gengzi: Shufei He was ordered invested empress.

sentences.zh: 上幸陟屺寺，宴從官于韓建所獻禦莊。

translations.literal: The emperor visited Shiji Temple and feasted his followers at the imperial estate Han Jian presented.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor visited Shiji Temple and feasted at Han Jian's presented estate.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳朔，以立後大赦。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jisi, the first day, a great amnesty was proclaimed for the empress's investiture.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jisi new moon: great amnesty for the empress.

sentences.zh: 汴將葛從周率眾攻李克用邢、洺、磁等州，陷之。

translations.literal: Bian general Ge Congzhou led troops against Li Keyong's Xing, Ming, and Ci and took them.
translations.idiomatic: Ge Congzhou took Keyong's Xing, Ming, and Ci.

sentences.zh: 全忠署從周為三州兵馬留後。

translations.literal: Quanzhong appointed Congzhou acting commissioner of the three prefectures' military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhong made Congzhou acting commissioner of the three prefectures.

sentences.zh: 六月己亥，帝幸西溪觀競渡。

translations.literal: On jihai, the emperor visited West Creek to watch the dragon-boat races.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the emperor watched dragon-boat races at West Creek.

sentences.zh: 天下籓牧、文武百僚上表，請車駕還京。

translations.literal: Feudatories and civil and military officials throughout the realm memorialized begging the imperial carriage return to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: All circuits memorialized begging return to the capital.

sentences.zh: 七月，汴將氏叔琮陷趙匡凝之隨、唐、鄧等州。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Bian general Shi Shuzong took Zhao Kuangning's Sui, Tang, and Deng.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Shi Shuzong took Kuangning's Sui, Tang, and Deng.

sentences.zh: 敕昇華州為興德府，剌史為尹，左右司馬為少尹，鄭縣為次赤，官員資望一同五府。

translations.literal: An edict raised Huazhou to Xingde Prefecture—the prefect became magistrate, left and right aides became vice magistrates, Zheng County became secondary red, and official standing matched the five prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Huazhou was raised to Xingde Prefecture with capital-grade officials.

sentences.zh: 封華嶽廟為佑順侯。

translations.literal: Mount Hua's temple was enfeoffed as Marquis Youshun.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Hua's temple was enfeoffed Marquis Youshun.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌朔。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on wuxu, the first day.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, wuxu new moon.

sentences.zh: 己未，車駕自華還京師。

translations.literal: On jiwei, the imperial carriage returned from Hua to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the carriage returned from Hua to the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲子，禦端門，大赦，改元光化。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the emperor faced the Duan Gate, proclaimed a great amnesty, and changed the era name to Guanghua.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he faced the Duan Gate, amnestied, and changed the era to Guanghua.

sentences.zh: 九月戊辰朔，以御史中丞狄歸昌為尚書左丞。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on wuchen, the first day, Vice Censor-in-Chief Di Guichang was made Left Assistant Director.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wuchen new moon: Di Guichang became left assistant director.

sentences.zh: 制以鎮國、匡國等軍節度使韓建守太傅、中書令、興德尹，封潁川郡王，賜鐵券，並禦寫「忠貞」以遺之。

translations.literal: An edict made Zhenguo and Kuangguo Commissioner Han Jian Guardian Grand Tutor, Director of the Secretariat, Xingde Magistrate, Prince of Yingchuan, granted an iron certificate, and the emperor's own hand wrote "Loyal and True" as gift.
translations.idiomatic: Han Jian was made grand tutor, director of the secretariat, Xingde magistrate, Prince of Yingchuan, with iron certificate and the emperor's "Loyal and True."

sentences.zh: 建累上表辭王爵，乃改封許國公。

translations.literal: Jian repeatedly memorialized declining the princedom and was changed to Duke of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: Jian repeatedly declined the princedom and was made Duke of Xu.

sentences.zh: 魏博節度使羅弘信進封臨清郡王。

translations.literal: Weibo Commissioner Luo Hongxin was advanced to Prince of Linqing.
translations.idiomatic: Weibo's Luo Hongxin was advanced to Prince of Linqing.

sentences.zh: 是月，弘信卒，贈太師，諡曰莊肅。

translations.literal: That month Hongxin died, posthumously made Grand Preceptor, posthumous title Zhuangsu.
translations.idiomatic: That month Hongxin died, posthumously grand preceptor Zhuangsu.

sentences.zh: 衙軍立其子副大使紹威知兵馬事，尋賜之節鉞。

translations.literal: The guard army installed his son Vice Commissioner Shaowei to know military affairs; soon he was granted the commander's seal.
translations.idiomatic: The guard army made Shaowei acting commander; soon he received the seal.

sentences.zh: 十月丁酉朔，河南尹張全義就加侍中。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on dingyou, the first day, Henan Magistrate Zhang Quanyi was further appointed Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, dingyou new moon: Zhang Quanyi was further made palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 汴將硃友恭自江西行營還，過安州，殺刺史武渝，遣部將守之。

translations.literal: Bian general Zhu Yougong returned from the Jiangxi campaign, passed Anzhou, killed Prefect Wu Yu, and left a subordinate to hold it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Yougong returned from Jiangxi, killed Anzhou prefect Wu Yu, and garrisoned it.

sentences.zh: 汴將張存敬以兵襲蔡州，刺史崔洪納款，請以弟賢質于汴，許之。

translations.literal: Bian general Zhang Cunjing raided Caizhou; Prefect Cui Hong submitted, asking to send his brother Xian as hostage to Bian; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Cunjing raided Caizhou; Cui Hong submitted and sent brother Xian as hostage; granted.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙寅，李克用將潞州節度使薛志勤死，澤州刺史李罕之乘其無帥，襲潞取之，遣其子顥乞降于汴，全忠表罕之為節度使。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Li Keyong's general Luzhou Commissioner Xue Zhiqin died; Zezhou Prefect Li Hanzhi, seizing the lack of a commander, raided Luzhou and took it, sent his son Hao to beg surrender to Bian; Quanzhong memorialized Hanzhi as commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Xue Zhiqin died; Li Hanzhi seized Luzhou and sent son Hao to surrender to Bian; Quanzhong made him commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月乙未朔。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guanghua, spring, the first month, on yiwei, the first day.
translations.idiomatic: Guanghua 2, spring, yiwei new moon.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以兵部尚書陸扆為兵部侍郎、同平章事。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Minister of War Lu Yi was made Vice Minister of War and Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Lu Yi became vice minister of war and grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 二月，蔡州刺史崔洪為衙兵所迫，同竄淮南。

translations.literal: In the second month, Caizhou Prefect Cui Hong was forced by guard troops and fled with them to Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: Second month: Cui Hong was forced by guards and fled to Huainan.

sentences.zh: 時洪以弟賢質于汴，汴人遣賢還蔡，徵兵三千出征。

translations.literal: At that time Hong had sent his brother Xian as hostage to Bian; Bian sent Xian back to Cai and drafted three thousand troops for campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Hong had sent Xian as hostage; Bian returned Xian and drafted three thousand troops.

sentences.zh: 蔡兵亂，殺賢，遂擁洪度淮。

translations.literal: Cai troops mutinied, killed Xian, and escorted Hong across the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Cai mutinied, killed Xian, and carried Hong south.

sentences.zh: 硃全忠令其子友裕守蔡州。

translations.literal: Zhu Quanzhong ordered his son Youyu to hold Caizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhong ordered son Youyu to hold Caizhou.

sentences.zh: 幽州節度使劉仁恭驅燕軍十萬，將兼趙、魏。

translations.literal: Youzhou Commissioner Liu Rengong drove a hundred thousand Yan troops intending to take Zhao and Wei together.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Rengong drove a hundred thousand Yan troops to take Zhao and Wei.

sentences.zh: 是月陷貝州，人無少長皆屠之，投屍清水，為之不流。

translations.literal: That month he took Beizhou; none young or old were spared; corpses were cast into Clear Water until it would not flow.
translations.idiomatic: That month he took Beizhou and slaughtered all; corpses choked Clear Water.

sentences.zh: 遂進攻魏州。

translations.literal: He then advanced on Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He then marched on Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 羅紹威求救於汴。

translations.literal: Luo Shaowei begged aid from Bian.
translations.idiomatic: Shaowei begged Bian for aid.

sentences.zh: 三月，朱全忠遣大將張存敬率師援之，屯于內黃。

translations.literal: In the third month, Zhu Quanzhong sent Grand General Zhang Cunjing with an army to aid him, encamped at Neihuang.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: Quanzhong sent Zhang Cunjing to aid him at Neihuang.

sentences.zh: 葛從周自邢、洺率勁騎八百入魏州。

translations.literal: Ge Congzhou from Xing and Ming led eight hundred crack horsemen into Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Ge Congzhou led eight hundred crack horsemen from Xing and Ming into Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 燕將劉守文、單可及聞汴軍在內黃，引軍往擊之。

translations.literal: Yan generals Liu Shouwen and Shan Keji, hearing Bian troops were at Neihuang, led armies to strike them.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shouwen and Shan Keji led armies to strike Bian troops at Neihuang.

sentences.zh: 存敬設伏內黃東，大敗燕軍，俘斬三萬，生擒單可及。

translations.literal: Cunjing set an ambush east of Neihuang and greatly defeated the Yan army, capturing and beheading thirty thousand and taking Shan Keji alive.
translations.idiomatic: Cunjing ambushed east of Neihuang, defeated Yan, beheaded thirty thousand, and captured Shan Keji.

sentences.zh: 劉守文以余眾還魏州，為存敬、從周所乘，燕軍復敗，仁恭父子僅免。

translations.literal: Liu Shouwen with the remainder returned to Weizhou; Cunjing and Congzhou pressed them; the Yan army was again defeated; Rengong and his sons barely escaped.
translations.idiomatic: Shouwen returned; Cunjing and Congzhou pressed; Yan was again defeated; Rengong and sons barely escaped.

sentences.zh: 汴、魏合兵躡之，趙人復邀之東境，自魏至滄五百里間，僵屍相枕。

translations.literal: Bian and Wei combined to pursue; Zhao men again intercepted on the eastern border—from Wei to Cang five hundred li, corpses lay pillow to pillow.
translations.idiomatic: Bian and Wei pursued; Zhao intercepted—from Wei to Cang corpses lay pillow to pillow.

sentences.zh: 是春，有白氣竟天如練，自西南徹東北，而旋有燕卒之敗。

translations.literal: That spring a white vapor stretched across heaven like silk from southwest through northeast—and soon came the Yan army's defeat.
translations.idiomatic: That spring white vapor stretched heaven like silk—and soon the Yan army fell.

sentences.zh: 四月，汴將氏叔琮由上党進軍攻太原，出石會，為沙陀擒其前鋒將陳章，叔琮乃退去。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Bian general Shi Shuzong advanced from Shangdang against Taiyuan, exited Shihui, and the Shatuo captured his vanguard general Chen Zhang; Shuzong then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month: Shi Shuzong advanced on Taiyuan; Shatuo captured Chen Zhang; he withdrew.

sentences.zh: 六月，制以昭義節度使、檢校太尉、兼太師、侍中、潞州大都督府長史、隴西郡開國公、食邑三千戶李罕之為孟州刺史，充河陽三城節度、孟懷觀察等使；

translations.literal: In the sixth month, an edict made Zhaoyi Commissioner Li Hanzhi, Acting Grand Guardian, concurrent Grand Preceptor, Palace Attendant, Luzhou Chief Administrator, Duke of Longxi with three thousand households, Prefect of Mengzhou, and Commissioner of Heyang Three Cities and Meng-Huai;
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: Li Hanzhi was made Mengzhou prefect and Heyang commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以檢校司徒、孟州刺史、河陽節度使丁會為澤、潞等節度使：從全忠奏也。

translations.literal: Acting Minister of Works Ding Hui, Mengzhou Prefect and Heyang Commissioner, was made Commissioner of Ze and Lu—following Quanzhong's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Hui was made Ze-Lu commissioner—per Quanzhong's memorial.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，李罕之至懷州，卒於傳舍。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Li Hanzhi reached Huaizhou and died at the relay station.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Li Hanzhi reached Huaizhou and died at the relay station.

sentences.zh: 陝州軍亂，殺其帥王珙，立都將軍李璠為留後。

translations.literal: Shanzhou troops mutinied, killed their commander Wang Gong, and installed Commandery General Li Fan as acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Shanzhou mutinied, killed Wang Gong, and made Li Fan acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，制以前太常卿劉崇望為吏部尚書，兵部侍郎裴樞為吏部侍郎，戶部侍郎薛昭緯為兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: On dinghai, an edict made former Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Liu Chongwang Minister of Personnel, Vice Minister of War Pei Shu Vice Minister of Personnel, and Vice Minister of Revenue Xue Zhaowei Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Liu Chongwang became minister of personnel; Pei Shu and Xue Zhaowei were shifted.

sentences.zh: 七月，青州守海州將牛從毅擁郡人投淮南，行密遂有海州。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Qingzhou's Haizhou defender Niu Congyi led the prefecture to Huainan; Xingmi then held Haizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Niu Congyi led Haizhou to Huainan; Xingmi held it.

sentences.zh: 十一月，陝州衙將硃簡殺李璠，自稱留後，降汴，全忠表簡為帥守。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Shanzhou guard Zhu Jian killed Li Fan, styled himself acting commissioner, submitted to Bian; Quanzhong memorialized Jian as commander.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: Zhu Jian killed Li Fan, submitted to Bian; Quanzhong made him commander.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月庚子朔，以禮部尚書裴贄為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: In the third year of Guanghua, spring, the first month, on gengzi, the first day, Minister of Rites Pei Zan was made Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Guanghua 3, spring, gengzi new moon: Pei Zan became minister of justice.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，朱全忠奏：「本貫宋州碭山縣，蒙恩升為輝州，其地卑濕，難葺廬舍，請移輝州治所于單父縣。

translations.literal: On guimao, Zhu Quanzhong memorialized: "My native place is Dangshan County, Songzhou; by grace it was raised to Huizhou; the land is low and wet, hard to build dwellings—I beg move Huizhou's seat to Shanfu County."
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Quanzhong begged move Huizhou's seat from damp Dangshan to Shanfu.

sentences.zh: 」從之，仍賜號為崇德軍。

translations.literal: " The edict was assented to, and the command was still granted the name Chongde Army.
translations.idiomatic: The edict was assented to and the command was named Chongde Army.

sentences.zh: 四月戊午，汴、魏合軍攻滄州，以報入郛之役，葛從周連陷滄德郡邑，王鎔遣使和解于全忠，令劉仁恭修好，汴、魏班師。

translations.literal: On the fourth month, wuwu, Bian and Wei combined to attack Cangzhou to avenge entering the outer wall; Ge Congzhou took Cangde districts in succession; Wang Rong sent envoys to Quanzhong for peace, ordering Liu Rengong reconcile; Bian and Wei withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, wuwu: Bian and Wei attacked Cangzhou; Congzhou took districts; Wang Rong sued for peace; armies withdrew.

sentences.zh: 辛未，皇后、太子謁九廟。

translations.literal: On xinwei, the empress and crown prince visited the Nine Temples.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei empress and crown prince visited the Nine Temples.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳，朱全忠表陝州兵馬留後硃簡鄉里同宗，改名友謙，乞真授節鉞。

translations.literal: On the sixth month, dingsi, Zhu Quanzhong memorialized that Shanzhou acting commissioner Zhu Jian was clan from his home district, renamed Youqian, and begged true investiture with the commander's seal.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, dingsi: Quanzhong said Zhu Jian was clan, renamed Youqian, and begged the seal.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The edict was assented to.
translations.idiomatic: The throne assented.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，特進、司空、門下侍郎、平章事、監修國史王摶貶崖州司戶，尋賜死于藍田驛，樞密使宋道弼、景務修並死。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Special Advancement Holder Wang Tuan, Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Secretariat, Grand Councilor, Commissioner for Editing the National History, was banished to Yazhou Registrar; soon ordered to die at Lantian Post; Commissioners of Military Affairs Song Daobi and Jing Wuxiu also died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Wang Tuan was banished then ordered to die at Lantian Post; Song Daobi and Jing Wuxiu also died.

sentences.zh: 為崔胤所誣，言三人中外相結也。

translations.literal: Cui Yin had slandered them, saying the three joined inner and outer court.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yin slandered them as joining inner and outer court.

sentences.zh: 七月丁亥朔，兵部尚書劉崇望卒，贈司空。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on dinghai, the first day, Minister of War Liu Chongwang died, posthumously made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, dinghai new moon: Liu Chongwang died, posthumously minister of works.

sentences.zh: 甲午，兵部郎中薛正表為右諫議大夫。

translations.literal: On jiawu, War Bureau Director Xue Zhengbiao was made Right Remonstrance Official.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Xue Zhengbiao became right remonstrance official.

sentences.zh: 以許州刺史硃友恭檢校司徒，為潁州刺史；

translations.literal: Xuzhou Prefect Zhu Yougong was made Acting Minister of Works and Prefect of Yingzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Yougong became acting minister of works and Yingzhou prefect;

sentences.zh: 以左武衛將軍趙霖檢左僕射，為許州刺史；

translations.literal: Left Martial Guard General Zhao Lin was made Acting Left Vice Director and Prefect of Xu;
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Lin became acting left vice director and Xu prefect;

sentences.zh: 宣武押衙劉知俊檢校右僕射，為鄭州刺史：從全忠奏也。

translations.literal: Xuanwu Escort Officer Liu Zhijun was made Acting Right Vice Director and Prefect of Zheng—following Quanzhong's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhijun became acting right vice director and Zheng prefect—per Quanzhong's memorial.

sentences.zh: 戊申，制以武貞軍節度、澧朗敘等州觀察處置等使、開府儀同三司、檢校司徒、同平章事、朗州刺史、上柱國、馮翊郡開國侯、食邑一千五百戶雷滿檢校太保，封馮翊郡王，餘如故。

translations.literal: On wushen, an edict made Wuzhen Commissioner Lei Man, Acting Grand Guardian, Prince of Fengyi, the rest unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Lei Man was made acting grand guardian and Prince of Fengyi.

sentences.zh: 以武泰軍節度、黔中觀察處置等使、光祿大夫、檢校尚書左僕射、黔州刺史、御史大夫、上柱國趙崇封天水縣開國子，食邑五百戶。

translations.literal: Wutai Commissioner Zhao Chong was enfeoffed Baron of Tianshui with five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Wutai Commissioner Zhao Chong was enfeoffed Baron of Tianshui.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，制昭義節度留後、光祿大夫、檢校司空、上柱國孟遷為檢校司徒，兼潞州大都府長史，充昭義節度副大使、知節度事、潞磁邢洺等州觀察處置使，仍封平昌縣男，食邑三百戶，從李克用奏也。

translations.literal: On gengxu, an edict made Zhaoyi Acting Commissioner Meng Qian Acting Minister of Works, concurrent Luzhou Chief Administrator, Zhaoyi Vice Commissioner knowing military affairs, Commissioner of Luzhou, Ming, Xing, and Mo, Baron of Pingchang with three hundred households—following Li Keyong's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Meng Qian was made acting minister of works and Zhaoyi vice commissioner—per Keyong's memorial.

sentences.zh: 以金紫光祿大夫、守兵部尚書、上柱國、樂安郡開國公、食邑一千五百戶孫儲守兵部尚書，兼京兆尹。

translations.literal: Golden-Gleam Grandee Sun Chu, Minister of War, Duke of Le'an, was ordered to keep the ministry and also serve as Jingzhao Magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Chu kept the ministry of war and also became Jingzhao magistrate.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，制忠烈衛聖鎮國功臣、劍南西川節度副大使、知節度事、管內營田觀察處置統押近界諸蠻兼西山八國雲南安撫制置等使、開府儀同三司、檢校太尉、中書令、成都尹、上柱國、琅邪郡王、食邑三千戶、實封一百戶王建可兼劍南東川、武信軍兩道都指揮制置等使，加食邑一千戶，餘如故。

translations.literal: On yimao, an edict: Loyal Martyr Guard-Sage Zhenguo Merit Holder Wang Jian, Sichuan West Vice Commissioner, could also command Sichuan East and Wuxin circuits, with fief increased one thousand households, the rest unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Wang Jian was given Sichuan East and Wuxin—he had taken Zizhou from Gu Yanhui.

sentences.zh: 時建攻下梓州顧彥暉，兼有東川洋、果、閬等州故也。

translations.literal: At that time Jian had taken Zizhou from Gu Yanhui and also held Sichuan East's Yang, Guo, and Lang.
translations.idiomatic: He had taken Zizhou and held Yang, Guo, and Lang.

sentences.zh: 又以忠義軍節度、山南東道管內觀察處置三司水陸發運等使、開府儀同三司、檢校太尉、中書令、兼襄州刺史、上柱國、南平王、食邑三千戶趙匡凝可檢校太師、兼中書令，加實封一百戶。

translations.literal: Loyalty Army Commissioner Zhao Kuangning was made Acting Grand Preceptor, concurrent Director of the Secretariat, with substantive fief increased one hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Kuangning was made acting grand preceptor and director of the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 八月丙辰朔，朱全忠奏：「先割汝州隸許州，請卻還東都。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on bingchen, the first day, Zhu Quanzhong memorialized: "Ru Prefecture was first cut to Xu—I beg return it to the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, bingchen new moon: Quanzhong begged return Ru Prefecture to the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 河陽先管澤州，今緣蕃戎佔據，得失不常，請權割河南府王屋、清河、鞏三縣隸河陽。

translations.literal: Heyang once governed Ze; now because border tribes hold it, gain and loss are uncertain—I beg temporarily cut Wangwu, Qinghe, and Gong of Henan to Heyang."
translations.idiomatic: He begged cut Wangwu, Qinghe, and Gong to uncertain Heyang."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The edict was assented to.
translations.idiomatic: The throne assented.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，制忠貞平難功臣、河東節度、管內觀察處置等使、開府儀同三司、守太師、兼中書令、北都留守、太原尹、上柱國、晉王、食邑九千戶、食實封七百戶李克用加實封一百戶。

translations.literal: On guihai, an edict: Loyal and True Pacifier Li Keyong, Hedong Commissioner, with substantive fief increased one hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Li Keyong's substantive fief was increased one hundred households.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以朝請大夫、虞部郎中、知制誥、上柱國、賜紫金魚袋顏蕘為中書舍人。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Court Gentleman Yan Rao, Works Bureau Director and Drafting Officer, was made Secretariat Draftsman.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Yan Rao became secretariat draftsman.

sentences.zh: 己巳，制前歸義軍節度副使、權知兵馬留後、銀青光祿大夫、檢校國子祭酒、監察御史、上柱國張承奉為檢校左散騎常侍，兼沙州刺史、御史大夫，充歸義節度、瓜沙伊西等州觀察處置押蕃落等使。

translations.literal: On jisi, an edict made former Guiyi Vice Commissioner Zhang Chengfeng Acting Left Regular Attendant, concurrent Shazhou Prefect and Censor-in-Chief, Commissioner of Guiyi and Guasha Yixi.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Zhang Chengfeng became Guiyi commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，太原大將李嗣昭攻洺州、下之，執汴將硃紹宗。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Taiyuan Grand General Li Sizhao attacked Mingzhou, took it, and seized Bian general Zhu Shaozong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Li Sizhao took Mingzhou and seized Zhu Shaozong.

sentences.zh: 汴將葛從周率師赴之，嗣昭棄城而去。

translations.literal: Bian general Ge Congzhou led troops to relieve it; Sizhao abandoned the city and left.
translations.idiomatic: Ge Congzhou relieved it; Sizhao abandoned the city.

sentences.zh: 從周邀之于青山口，晉軍大敗，從周乘勝攻鎮州。

translations.literal: Congzhou intercepted him at Qingshan Pass; Jin troops were greatly defeated; Congzhou pressed the victory and attacked Zhenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Congzhou intercepted at Qingshan; Jin was crushed; he attacked Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬午，制荊南節度、忠萬歸夔涪峽等州觀察處置水陸催運等使、開府儀同三司、檢校太尉、兼中書令、江陵尹、上柱國、上谷郡王、食邑三千戶成汭可檢校太師、中書令，余如故。

translations.literal: On renwu, an edict: Jingnan Commissioner Cheng Run could be Acting Grand Preceptor and Director of the Secretariat, the rest unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Cheng Run was made acting grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 甲申，制扶危匡國致理功臣、特進、行尚書左僕射、兼門下侍郎、同平章事、監修國史、判度支、上柱國、清河郡開國公、食邑二千戶崔胤可開府儀同三司，進封魏國公，加食邑一千戶，餘如故。

translations.literal: On jiashen, an edict: Cui Yin, Pacifier and Rectifier Merit Holder, could be Grand Master of Honor with Golden Seal, advanced to Duke of Wei with fief increased one thousand households, the rest unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Cui Yin was advanced to Duke of Wei.

sentences.zh: 九月丙戌朔，朱全忠引三鎮之師攻鎮州，王鎔懼，遣判官周式、副大使王昭祚、主事梁公儒子弟為質於汴，出犒師絹十五萬匹求盟，許之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingxu, the first day, Zhu Quanzhong led three commands' armies against Zhenzhou; Wang Rong was afraid and sent Judge Zhou Shi, Vice Commissioner Wang Zhaozuo, and Chief Clerk Liang Gongru's sons as hostages to Bian, presenting one hundred fifty thousand bolts of silk to sue for peace; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, bingxu new moon: Quanzhong attacked Zhenzhou; Wang Rong sent hostages and silk for peace; granted.

sentences.zh: 張存敬遂自深、冀進軍，攻瀛、莫，下郡邑二十，阻雨泥濘，不及幽州。

translations.literal: Zhang Cunjing then advanced from Shen and Ji, attacked Ying and Mo, took twenty districts; rain and mud blocked reaching Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Cunjing took twenty districts; rain and mud blocked Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 遂西行陷祁州，大敗中山將王處直軍於沙河北，進屯懷德驛。

translations.literal: He then turned west, took Qizhou, greatly defeated Zhongshan general Wang Chuzhi's army north of Shahe, and encamped at Huaide Post.
translations.idiomatic: He took Qizhou, defeated Wang Chuzhi north of Shahe, and encamped at Huaide.

sentences.zh: 遂攻定州，節度使王郜奔太原，衙將王處直斬孔目官梁汶，出縑二十萬乞盟，許之。

translations.literal: He then attacked Dingzhou; Commissioner Wang Gao fled to Taiyuan; guard Wang Chuzhi beheaded clerk Liang Wen and offered two hundred thousand bolts of silk to sue for peace; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: He attacked Dingzhou; Gao fled; Chuzhi beheaded Liang Wen and bought peace with silk.

sentences.zh: 全忠遂署王處直為義武軍留後。

translations.literal: Quanzhong then appointed Wang Chuzhi acting Yiwu Army commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhong appointed Wang Chuzhi acting Yiwu commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，制扶危匡國致理功臣、開府儀同三司、守太保、兼門下侍郎、平章事，充太清宮使、修奉太廟使、弘文館大學士、延資庫使、諸道鹽鐵轉運等使、上柱國、齊國公、食邑五千戶、食實封一百戶徐彥若可檢校太尉、同平章事，充清海軍節度、嶺南東道管內觀察處置供軍糧料等使。

translations.literal: On yisi, an edict: Xu Yanruo could be Acting Grand Guardian, Grand Councilor, Commissioner of Qinghai and Lingnan East.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Xu Yanruo was made acting grand guardian and Qinghai commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙午，制光祿大夫、中書侍郎、兼吏部尚書、同平章事、充集賢殿大學士、判戶部事、博陵郡開國公、食邑二千戶崔遠罷知政事，守本官。

translations.literal: On bingwu, an edict: Cui Yuan left government affairs and kept his post.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Cui Yuan left government and kept his post.

sentences.zh: 戊申，制左僕射、門下侍郎、平章事、監修國史、判度支崔胤充太清宮使、修奉太廟使、弘文館大學士、延資庫使，依前判度支，兼充諸道鹽鐵運等使。

translations.literal: On wushen, an edict: Left Vice Director Cui Yin was made Commissioner of Grand Pure Palace, Temple Repair, Hongwen Hall, Extended Treasury, and Salt and Iron Transport, continuing to control revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Cui Yin took palace, temple, and transport commissions.

sentences.zh: 光祿大夫、中書侍郎，兼戶部尚書、同平章事、上柱國、吳郡開國公、食邑一千五百戶陸扆為門下侍郎、戶部尚書、監修國史。

translations.literal: Golden-Gleam Grandee Lu Yi was made Vice Director of the Secretariat, Minister of Revenue, Commissioner for Editing the National History.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Yi became vice director of the secretariat and revenue minister.

sentences.zh: 以正議大夫、守刑部尚書、上柱國、河東縣開國男、食邑三百戶、賜紫金魚袋裴贄為中書侍郎，兼刑部尚書、同平章事，充集賢殿大學士。

translations.literal: Proper Counselor Pei Zan was made Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of Justice and Grand Councilor, Grand Scholar of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Zan became vice director and grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 以銀青光祿大夫、行尚書吏部侍郎、上柱國裴樞為中書侍郎、同平章事，判戶部事。

translations.literal: Silver-Gleam Grandee Pei Shu was made Vice Director of the Secretariat, Grand Councilor, and Controller of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Shu became vice director, grand councilor, and revenue controller.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以光祿大夫、尚書右僕射、租庸使張浚罷租庸使，守本官。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Grandee Zhang Jun, Right Vice Director and Tribute Commissioner, left the tribute commission and kept his post.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Zhang Jun left the tribute commission.

sentences.zh: 十月丙辰朔。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on bingchen, the first day.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, bingchen new moon.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以前清海軍節度副使、朝散大夫、檢校左散騎常侍、御史大夫、上柱國王溥守左散騎常侍，充鹽鐵副使。

translations.literal: On xinyou, former Qinghai Vice Commissioner Wang Pu was ordered to keep Left Regular Attendant and serve as Salt and Iron Vice Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Wang Pu became salt and iron vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸未，制以保義軍節度留後、銀青光祿大夫、檢校戶部尚書、兼御史大夫、上柱國硃友謙為金紫光祿大夫、檢校尚書右僕射，兼陝州大都督府長史、御史大夫，充保義軍節度、陝虢觀察處置等使。

translations.literal: On guimao, an edict made Baoyi Acting Commissioner Zhu Youqian Golden-Gleam Grandee, Acting Right Vice Director, concurrent Shanzhou Chief Administrator and Censor-in-Chief, Commissioner of Baoyi and Shan-Guo.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Zhu Youqian was made Baoyi commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉朔。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on yiyou, the first day.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, yiyou new moon.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，左右軍中尉劉季述、王仲先廢昭宗，幽於東內問安宮，請皇太子裕監國。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Inner Army Commanders Liu Jishu and Wang Zhongxian deposed Zhaozong, confined him in the Eastern Inner Ask-Peace Palace, and asked Crown Prince Yu to supervise the state.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Liu Jishu and Wang Zhongxian deposed Zhaozong and made Yu regent.

sentences.zh: 時昭宗委崔胤以執政，胤恃全忠之助，稍抑宦官。

translations.literal: At that time Zhaozong entrusted Cui Yin with government; Yin relied on Quanzhong's aid and gradually checked the eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaozong entrusted Yin with government; he relied on Quanzhong and checked eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 而帝自華還宮後，頗以禽酒肆志，喜怒不常，自宋道弼等得罪，黃門尤懼。

translations.literal: After returning from Hua to the palace the emperor indulged in birds, wine, and willfulness, joy and anger unsteady; after Song Daobi and others were punished the Yellow Gates feared especially.
translations.idiomatic: After returning from Hua he indulged in birds and wine; eunuchs feared after Song Daobi's fall.

sentences.zh: 至是，上獵苑中，醉甚，是夜，手殺黃門、侍女數人。

translations.literal: At this time the emperor hunted in the park, drunk deeply; that night he personally killed several yellow gates and serving women.
translations.idiomatic: He hunted drunk that night and killed several eunuchs and serving women.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，日及辰巳，內門不開。

translations.literal: On gengyin, when the day reached chen and si hours, the inner gates did not open.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin by mid-morning the inner gates did not open.

sentences.zh: 劉季述詣中書謂宰相崔胤曰：「宮中必有不測之事，人臣安得坐觀？

translations.literal: Liu Jishu went to the Secretariat and told Grand Councilor Cui Yin: "Within the palace there must be unforeseen events—how can ministers sit and watch?
translations.idiomatic: Jishu told Yin: "The palace must hold disaster—how can we sit and watch?

sentences.zh: 我等內臣也，可以便宜從事。

translations.literal: We are inner servants and may act as expedience requires."
translations.idiomatic: We inner servants may act at expedience."

sentences.zh: 」即以禁兵千人破關而入，問訊中人，具知其故。

translations.literal: He at once broke in with a thousand forbidden troops, questioned the inner staff, and learned the whole cause.
translations.idiomatic: He broke in with a thousand guards, questioned staff, and learned all.

sentences.zh: 即出與宰臣謀曰：「主上所為如此，非社稷之主也。

translations.literal: Coming out he plotted with the chancellors: "The ruler's conduct is such—he is no lord of the altars.
translations.idiomatic: He told chancellors: "The ruler's conduct is not that of altars' lord.

sentences.zh: 廢昏立明，具有故事，國家大計，非逆亂也。

translations.literal: Depose the dim and establish the bright—there are precedents; it is the state's great plan, not rebellion."
translations.idiomatic: Depose the dim for the bright—precedent exists; it is statecraft, not rebellion."

sentences.zh: 」即召百官署狀，崔胤等不獲已署之。

translations.literal: He at once summoned the hundred officials to sign; Cui Yin and others had no choice and signed.
translations.idiomatic: He summoned officials to sign; Yin and others had no choice.

sentences.zh: 季述、仲先與汴州進奏官程岩等十三人請對，對訖，季述上殿待罪次。

translations.literal: Jishu, Zhongxian, and thirteen others including Bian memorial officer Cheng Yan requested audience; when audience ended Jishu ascended the hall to await punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Jishu, Zhongxian, Cheng Yan, and thirteen others requested audience; Jishu awaited punishment.

sentences.zh: 左右軍將士齊唱萬歲聲，遂突入宣化門，行至思政殿，便行殺戮，徑至乞巧樓下。

translations.literal: Inner and outer army soldiers together shouted ten thousand years, burst through Xuanhua Gate, marched to Sizheng Hall, killed as they went, straight to Qiqiao Tower.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers shouted ten thousand years, burst through Xuanhua Gate, killed to Qiqiao Tower.

sentences.zh: 帝遽見兵士，驚墮床下，起而將去，季述、仲先掖而令坐。

translations.literal: The emperor suddenly saw soldiers, startled and fell from the bed, rose to flee; Jishu and Zhongxian supported him and made him sit.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor fell from bed; Jishu and Zhongxian forced him to sit.

sentences.zh: 何皇后遽出拜曰：「軍容長官護官家，勿至驚恐，有事取軍容商量。

translations.literal: Empress He hurried out to bow: "Army superiors protect the Imperial Father—do not frighten him; take matters to the army superiors for counsel."
translations.idiomatic: Empress He bowed: "Protect the Imperial Father; take matters to the army superiors."

sentences.zh: 」季述即出百官合同狀，曰：「陛下倦臨寶位，中外群情，願太子監國，請陛下頤養于東宮。

translations.literal: Jishu produced the hundred officials' joint document: "Your Majesty is weary of the throne; inner and outer wish the crown prince supervise the state—I beg Your Majesty nurture yourself in the Eastern Palace."
translations.idiomatic: Jishu produced the joint document begging the crown prince supervise the state.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「吾昨與卿等歡飲，不覺太過，何至此耶！

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Yesterday I drank merrily with you and did not notice going too far—how reach this!"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Yesterday we drank too merrily—how reach this!"

sentences.zh: 」皇后曰：「聖人依他軍容語。

translations.literal: The empress said: "The Sage obeys the army superiors' words."
translations.idiomatic: The empress said: "Obey the army superiors."

sentences.zh: 」即于御前取國寶付季述，即時帝與皇后共一輦，並常所侍從十余內人赴東宮。

translations.literal: She took the imperial seal before the throne and gave it to Jishu; at once emperor and empress shared one carriage with a dozen usual attendants to the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: She gave the seal to Jishu; emperor and empress went to the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 入後，季述手自扃鎖院門，日於窗中通食器。

translations.literal: Within, Jishu himself barred the courtyard gate and daily passed food through the window.
translations.idiomatic: Jishu barred the gate and passed food through the window.

sentences.zh: 是日，迎皇太子監國，矯宣昭宗命稱上皇。

translations.literal: That day the crown prince was welcomed to supervise the state; a forged edict in Zhaozong's name styled him Retired Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: That day Yu supervised the state; a forged edict styled Zhaozong Retired Emperor.

sentences.zh: 甲午，宣上皇制，太子登皇帝位，宰臣、百僚、方鎮加爵進秩，又賜百僚銀一千五百兩、絹千匹、綿萬兩充救接，皆季述求媚於朝也。

translations.literal: On jiawu, the Retired Emperor's edict was proclaimed; the crown prince ascended the throne; chancellors, officials, and feudatories received rank increases; a thousand five hundred taels of silver, a thousand bolts of silk, and ten thousand liang of cotton were given officials for relief—all Jishu's flattery to court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the crown prince ascended; ranks and gifts flowed—all Jishu's flattery.

sentences.zh: 時朱全忠在定州行營，崔胤與前左僕射張浚告難於全忠，請以兵問罪，全忠自行營還大樑。

translations.literal: At that time Zhu Quanzhong was at the Dingzhou campaign; Cui Yin and former Left Vice Director Zhang Jun reported the crisis to Quanzhong, begging troops to punish wrong; Quanzhong returned from camp to Daliang.
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhong was at Dingzhou; Yin and Zhang Jun begged troops; he returned to Daliang.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯朔。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on yimao, the first day.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, yimao new moon.

sentences.zh: 癸未夜。

translations.literal: On guimao night.
translations.idiomatic: That guimao night.

sentences.zh: 護駕鹽州都將孫德昭、周承誨、董彥弼以兵攻劉季述、王仲先，殺仲先，攜其首詣東宮門，呼曰：「逆賊王仲先已斬首訖，請陛下出宮慰諭兵士。

translations.literal: Escort generals Sun Dezhao, Zhou Chenghui, and Dong Yanbi of Yanzhou attacked Liu Jishu and Wang Zhongxian, killed Zhongxian, and carried his head to the Eastern Palace gate crying: "Rebel Wang Zhongxian is beheaded—I beg Your Majesty leave the palace to comfort the troops."
translations.idiomatic: Sun Dezhao and others killed Zhongxian and begged the emperor out.

sentences.zh: 」宮人破鑰，帝與皇后方得出。

translations.literal: Palace women broke the lock; only then could emperor and empress emerge.
translations.idiomatic: Palace women broke the lock; emperor and empress emerged.

sentences.zh: 天復元年春正月甲申朔，昭宗反正，登長樂門樓，受朝賀。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianfu, spring, the first month, on jiashen, the first day, Zhaozong was restored, ascended Changle Gate Tower, and received audience congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: Tianfu 1, spring, jiashen new moon: Zhaozong was restored and received congratulations.

sentences.zh: 班未退，孫德昭執劉季述至樓前，上方詰責，已為亂棒擊死，乃屍之於市。

translations.literal: Before the audience retired Sun Dezhao brought Liu Jishu before the tower; as the emperor reproached him he was already beaten to death by the mob and exposed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Dezhao brought Jishu; the mob beat him dead and exposed him.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，制以孫德昭檢校司空，充靜海軍節度使。

translations.literal: On yiyou, an edict made Sun Dezhao Acting Minister of Works and Commissioner of Jinghai Army.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Sun Dezhao was made Jinghai commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，宰相崔胤進位司空。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Grand Councilor Cui Yin was advanced to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Cui Yin was advanced to minister of works.

sentences.zh: 己丑，朱全忠械程岩，折足檻送京師，戮之於市。

translations.literal: On jichou, Zhu Quanzhong shackled Cheng Yan, broke his feet in a cangue, sent him to the capital, and executed him in the market.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Quanzhong shackled Cheng Yan and executed him in the market.

sentences.zh: 制皇太子裕降為德王，改名祐。

translations.literal: Edict: Crown Prince Yu was demoted to Prince of De, renamed You.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Yu was demoted to Prince of De, renamed You.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，制以孫德昭為安南節度、檢校太保。

translations.literal: On gengyin, an edict made Sun Dezhao Annan Commissioner and Acting Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Sun Dezhao was made Annan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 以周承誨為邕州刺史、邕管節度經略使，以董彥弼為容州刺史、容管節度等使，並檢校太保、同平章事。

translations.literal: Zhou Chenghui was made Yongzhou Prefect and Yong Circuit Commissioner; Dong Yanbi Rongzhou Prefect and Rong Circuit Commissioner—both Acting Grand Guardian and Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Chenghui and Dong Yanbi were made commissioners and grand councilors.

sentences.zh: 殺神策軍使李師虔、徐彥回。

translations.literal: Shence Army commissioners Li Shiqian and Xu Yanhui were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shiqian and Xu Yanhui were executed.

sentences.zh: 敕曰：「朕臨禦已來，十有四載，常慕好生之德，固無樂殺之心。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Since I began ruling, fourteen years have passed; I always admired the virtue of cherishing life and firmly had no heart to delight in killing."
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Fourteen years I have ruled, cherishing life, never delighting in killing."

sentences.zh: 昨季述等幽辱朕躬，迫脅太子。

translations.literal: Yesterday Jishu and others humiliated my person and coerced the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: Yesterday Jishu humiliated me and coerced the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 李師虔是逆賊親厚，選來東內主持，動息之間，俾其偵伺。

translations.literal: Li Shiqian was the rebels' close associate, chosen to oversee the Eastern Inner; in every movement he spied.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shiqian was the rebels' associate, chosen to spy in the Eastern Inner.

sentences.zh: 每有須索，皆不供承。

translations.literal: Whenever there was need he would not supply.
translations.idiomatic: He supplied nothing they needed.

sentences.zh: 要紙筆則恐作詔書，索錐刀則慮為利器，淩辱萬狀，出入搜羅。

translations.literal: If paper and brush were sought he feared a forged edict; if awl and knife were sought he feared weapons—insult in ten thousand forms, going out searched.
translations.idiomatic: Paper and brush he feared were edicts; awl and knife he feared were weapons—searched going out.

sentences.zh: 朕所禦之衣，晝服夜濯，凝冽之際，寒苦難勝。

translations.literal: The clothes I wore were worn by day and washed by night; in freezing cold hardship was unbearable.
translations.idiomatic: Clothes were worn by day, washed by night; freezing cold was unbearable.

sentences.zh: 嬪嬙公主，衾裯皆闕。

translations.literal: Consorts and princesses lacked quilts.
translations.idiomatic: Consorts and princesses had no bedding.

sentences.zh: 緡錢則貫百不入，繒帛則尺寸難求。

translations.literal: Cash by the hundred would not enter; silk not an inch could be found.
translations.idiomatic: Cash by the hundred never came; silk by the inch could not be found.

sentences.zh: 六輩同其主張，五人權其威勢。

translations.literal: Six eunuchs together directed; five men wielded their power.
translations.idiomatic: Six eunuchs directed; five men wielded power.

sentences.zh: 若言狀罪，翰墨難窮，若許生全，是為貸法，宜並處斬。

translations.literal: If their crimes were written, brush could not exhaust them; if life were granted it would violate law—they should all be executed."
translations.idiomatic: Their crimes exhaust writing; grant life and law is violated—they should all be executed."

sentences.zh: 」時朱全忠既服河朔三鎮，欲窺圖王室篡代之謀，以李克用在太原，懼其角逐。

translations.literal: At that time Zhu Quanzhong had subdued the three Hebei commands and wished to spy on the royal house for usurpation; Li Keyong at Taiyuan made him fear rivalry.
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhong had subdued Hebei and eyed the throne; Keyong at Taiyuan made him fear rivalry.

sentences.zh: 是月，全忠令大將張存敬率兵三萬，由含山襲河中王珂。

translations.literal: That month Quanzhong ordered Grand General Zhang Cunjing with thirty thousand troops by Hanshan to raid Hezhong's Wang Ke.
translations.idiomatic: That month Quanzhong sent Zhang Cunjing with thirty thousand by Hanshan against Wang Ke.

sentences.zh: 晉州刺史張漢瑜、絳州刺史、陶建不意賊至，城守無備，皆以郡降。

translations.literal: Jinzhou Prefect Zhang Hanyu and Jiangzhou Prefect Tao Jian did not expect the enemy; the cities were unprepared and both prefectures surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Jin and Jiang prefectures were unprepared and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 存敬移兵圍河中，王珂求救於太原，克用不能救，乃嬰城謂存敬曰：「吾與汴王有舊，俟王至即降。

translations.literal: Cunjing moved to besiege Hezhong; Wang Ke begged Taiyuan; Keyong could not save him and held the city telling Cunjing: "I have old ties with the Prince of Bian—when the prince arrives I shall submit."
translations.idiomatic: Cunjing besieged Hezhong; Ke begged Taiyuan; Keyong could not save him; Ke said he would submit when Quanzhong arrived.

sentences.zh: 」二月甲寅朔。

translations.literal: " Thus ended his pledge.
translations.idiomatic: Thus he ended.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，硃全忠至河中，遂移王珂及兄璘、弟瓚舉室徙於汴，以張存敬守河中。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jiayin, the first day.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jiayin new moon.

sentences.zh: 是月，制以全忠檢校太師、守中書令，進封梁王。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Zhu Quanzhong reached Hezhong, moved Wang Ke with brothers Lin and Zan and the whole household to Bian, and left Zhang Cunjing to hold Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Quanzhong reached Hezhong, moved Wang Ke's household to Bian, and left Cunjing.

sentences.zh: 三月癸未朔，全忠引軍歸汴，奏：「河中節度使歲貢課鹽三千車，臣今代領池場，請加二千車，歲貢五千車。

translations.literal: That month an edict made Quanzhong Acting Grand Preceptor, Guardian Director of the Secretariat, advanced to Prince of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: That month Quanzhong was made Prince of Liang.

sentences.zh: 候五池完葺，則依平時供訂額。

translations.literal: In the third month, on guimao, the first day, Quanzhong led the army back to Bian and memorialized: "The Hezhong commissioner yearly presented three thousand cartloads of salt—I now hold the pools and beg add two thousand, yearly five thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, guimao new moon: Quanzhong memorialized for five thousand cartloads of salt yearly.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: When the five pools are fully repaired, supply according to the usual fixed quota."
translations.idiomatic: When pools are repaired, supply the usual quota."

sentences.zh: 四月癸丑朔，汴軍大舉攻太原，氏叔琮以兵三萬由天井關進攻澤潞，節度使孟遷以上黨降。

translations.literal: The edict was assented to.
translations.idiomatic: The throne assented.

sentences.zh: 叔琮長驅出圍柏，營於洞渦驛。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on guichou, the first day, Bian troops massed against Taiyuan; Shi Shuzong with thirty thousand by Tianjing Pass attacked Ze and Lu; Commissioner Meng Qian surrendered Shangdang.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, guichou new moon: Bian massed against Taiyuan; Meng Qian surrendered Shangdang.

sentences.zh: 葛從周率趙、魏、中山之兵由土門入，陷承天軍，與叔琮會。

translations.literal: Shuzong drove out encircling Bai, encamped at Donghuo Post.
translations.idiomatic: Shuzong encamped at Donghuo Post.

sentences.zh: 時屬大雨，芻糧不給，汴將保眾而還。

translations.literal: Ge Congzhou led Zhao, Wei, and Zhongshan troops through Tumen, took Chengtian Army, and joined Shuzong.
translations.idiomatic: Ge Congzhou took Chengtian Army and joined Shuzong.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，天子有事于宗廟。

translations.literal: It was heavy rain; fodder failed; Bian generals held the masses and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy rain; fodder failed; Bian generals withdrew.

sentences.zh: 是日，禦長樂門，大赦天下，改元天復。

translations.literal: That day he faced Changle Gate, amnestied all under Heaven, and changed the era name to Tianfu.
translations.idiomatic: That day he amnestied and changed the era to Tianfu.

sentences.zh: 李茂貞自鎮來朝，賜宴于壽春殿，進錢數萬緡。

translations.literal: Li Maozhen came from his command to audience and was feasted at Shouchun Hall, presenting tens of thousands of strings of cash.
translations.idiomatic: Maozhen came to audience, was feasted at Shouchun Hall, and presented tens of thousands in cash.

sentences.zh: 時中尉韓全誨及北司與茂貞相善，宰相崔胤與硃全忠相善，四人各為表裏。

translations.literal: At that time Inner Commander Han Quanhui and the Northern Office were friendly with Maozhen; Grand Councilor Cui Yin was friendly with Quanzhong—the four each formed inner and outer pairs.
translations.idiomatic: Han Quanhui favored Maozhen; Cui Yin favored Quanzhong—four men, two pairs.

sentences.zh: 全忠欲遷都洛陽，茂貞欲迎駕鳳翔，各有挾天子令諸侯之意。

translations.literal: Quanzhong wished to move the capital to Luoyang; Maozhen wished to welcome the carriage to Fengxiang—each held the emperor to command the feudatories.
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhong wanted Luoyang; Maozhen wanted Fengxiang—each held the emperor to command lords.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午朔。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on renwu, the first day.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, renwu new moon.

sentences.zh: 庚子，制門下侍郎、戶部尚書、平章事陸扆加兵部尚書，進階特進。

translations.literal: On gengzi, an edict made Vice Director Lu Yi also Minister of War and advanced to Special Advancement.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Lu Yi was also made minister of war and special advancement holder.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，制以朱全忠兼河中尹、河中節度、晉絳慈隰觀察處置、安邑解縣兩池榷鹽制置等使。

translations.literal: On renyin, an edict made Zhu Quanzhong concurrent Hezhong Magistrate, Hezhong Commissioner, Jin-Jiang-Ci-Wei Commissioner, and Commissioner of Anyi and Jie Salt Pools.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Quanzhong took Hezhong and salt pools.

sentences.zh: 閏六月辛巳朔，制以河陽節度丁會依前檢校司徒，兼潞州大都督府長史、昭義節度等使，代孟遷；

translations.literal: In the intercalary sixth month, on xinsi, the first day, an edict made Heyang Commissioner Ding Hui continue Acting Minister of Works, concurrent Luzhou Chief Administrator and Zhaoyi Commissioner, replacing Meng Qian;
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary sixth month, xinsi new moon: Ding Hui replaced Meng Qian at Zhaoyi;

sentences.zh: 以遷檢校司徒，為河陽節度。

translations.literal: Qian was made Acting Minister of Works and Heyang Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Qian was made Heyang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 全忠奏也。

translations.literal: Quanzhong's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Per Quanzhong's memorial.

sentences.zh: 仍請於昭義節度官階內落下邢、洺、磁三州，卻以澤州為屬郡，其河陽節度只以懷州為屬郡，從之。

translations.literal: He also asked drop Xing, Ming, and Ci from Zhaoyi's rank and make Ze a subordinate prefecture; Heyang should have only Huai as subordinate; the edict was assented to.
translations.idiomatic: He asked drop Xing, Ming, and Ci from Zhaoyi; the edict was assented to.

sentences.zh: 全忠又奏請以齊州隸鄆州，從之。

translations.literal: Quanzhong again memorialized begging Qi Prefecture be subordinate to Yan; the edict was assented to.
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhong begged Qi subordinate to Yan; the edict was assented to.

sentences.zh: 十月己卯朔。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on jimao, the first day.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, jimao new moon.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，全忠引四鎮之師七萬赴河中，京師聞之大恐，豪民皆亡竄山谷。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Quanzhong led seventy thousand troops of four commands to Hezhong; the capital heard and greatly feared; magnates fled into valleys.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Quanzhong led seventy thousand to Hezhong; the capital fled.

sentences.zh: 十一月己酉朔。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiyou, the first day.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jiyou new moon.

sentences.zh: 壬子，中尉韓全誨與鳳翔護駕都將李繼誨奉車駕出幸鳳翔。

translations.literal: On renzi, Inner Commander Han Quanhui and Fengxiang Escort Commander Li Jihui led the imperial carriage out to Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Han Quanhui and Li Jihui led the carriage to Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 是日，汴軍陷同州，執州將司馬鄴，華州節度使韓建遣判官李巨川送款。

translations.literal: That day Bian troops took Tongzhou and seized Prefect Sima Ye; Huazhou Commissioner Han Jian sent Judge Li Juchuan to submit.
translations.idiomatic: That day Bian took Tongzhou; Han Jian submitted.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，汴軍駐靈口。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Bian troops encamped at Lingkou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Bian troops encamped at Lingkou.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，全忠知帝出幸，乃回兵攻華州。

translations.literal: On yimao, learning the emperor had departed, Quanzhong turned to attack Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Quanzhong turned to attack Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 大軍駐赤水，全忠以親兵駐西溪。

translations.literal: The great army encamped at Chishui; Quanzhong's personal troops encamped at West Creek.
translations.idiomatic: The army encamped at Chishui; Quanzhong at West Creek.

sentences.zh: 韓建出降，乃署為忠武軍節度使，以陳州為理所。

translations.literal: Han Jian came out to surrender; he was appointed Zhongwu Commissioner with Chenzhou as seat.
translations.idiomatic: Han Jian surrendered and was made Zhongwu commissioner at Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，宰相崔胤令戶部侍郎王溥至赤水砦，促全忠以兵迎駕。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Grand Councilor Cui Yin sent Vice Minister of Revenue Wang Pu to Chishui camp to urge Quanzhong with troops to welcome the carriage.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Yin sent Wang Pu to urge Quanzhong welcome the carriage.

sentences.zh: 戊午，全忠自赤水趨長安，崔胤率文武百僚太子太師盧知猷已下迎全忠於坡頭。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Quanzhong hastened from Chishui toward Chang'an; Yin led civil and military officials and Grand Preceptor Lu Zhiyou and below to welcome Quanzhong at Potou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Quanzhong hastened to Chang'an; Yin welcomed him at Potou.

sentences.zh: 庚申，汴軍趨鳳翔。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Bian troops hastened toward Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Bian troops hastened toward Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，至岐下。

translations.literal: On wuchen, they reached below Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen they reached below Qi.

sentences.zh: 全忠令判官李擇、裴鑄入城奏事，言：「臣在河中，得崔胤書，言奉密詔令臣以兵士迎駕，臣不敢擅自迎鑾。

translations.literal: Quanzhong sent Judges Li Ze and Pei Zhu into the city to memorialize: "At Hezhong I received Yin's letter with a secret edict ordering me to welcome the carriage with troops—I dared not welcome on my own."
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhong said he dared not welcome the carriage on a secret edict alone.

sentences.zh: 」昭宗怒胤矯命，連詔全忠以兵士還鎮。

translations.literal: Zhaozong was angry at Yin's forged order and repeatedly edicted Quanzhong to return troops to his command.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaozong was angry at the forged order and told Quanzhong return troops.

sentences.zh: 辛未，全忠引軍離鳳翔，退攻邠州。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Quanzhong led troops from Fengxiang, withdrew, and attacked Binzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Quanzhong left Fengxiang and attacked Binzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，制扶危致理功臣、開府儀同三司、守司空、門下侍郎、平章事、充太清宮使、弘文館大學士、延資庫使、諸道鹽鐵轉運等使、判度支、上柱國、魏國公、食邑五千戶、食實封二百戶崔胤可責授朝散大夫、守工部尚書。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, an edict: Pacifier Merit Holder Cui Yin was demoted to Court Gentleman for Consultation, Guardian Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Cui Yin was demoted to consultation gentleman.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，邠州節度使李繼徽以城降，全忠乃舍其孥於河中，以繼徽從軍。

translations.literal: On yihai, Binzhou Commissioner Li Jihui surrendered the city; Quanzhong left his family at Hezhong and took Jihui with the army.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Li Jihui surrendered; Quanzhong took him with the army.

sentences.zh: 以汴軍營于三原。

translations.literal: Bian troops encamped at Sanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Bian encamped at Sanyuan.

sentences.zh: 十二月己卯，崔胤自長安至三原砦，與全忠謀攻鳳翔。

translations.literal: On jimao, Cui Yin came from Chang'an to Sanyuan camp and plotted with Quanzhong to attack Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Yin came to Sanyuan and plotted attack Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月戊申朔，車駕在鳳翔。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianfu, spring, the first month, on wushen, the first day, the imperial carriage was at Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Tianfu 2, spring, wushen new moon: the carriage was at Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 全忠在三原，李克用遣大將周德威攻慈、隰、晉等州。

translations.literal: Quanzhong was at Sanyuan; Li Keyong sent Grand General Zhou Dewei to attack Ci, Wei, and Jin.
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhong was at Sanyuan; Keyong sent Zhou Dewei against Ci, Wei, and Jin.

sentences.zh: 全忠歸河中，令其將硃友甯率眾五萬屯絳州，大敗太原軍于蒲縣西北，友甯乘勝追奔，陷汾州，進圍太原。

translations.literal: Quanzhong returned to Hezhong and ordered Zhu Youning with fifty thousand to camp at Jiangzhou; he greatly defeated Taiyuan troops northwest of Pu County; Youning pressed pursuit, took Fenzhou, and besieged Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhong sent Youning, who defeated Taiyuan and besieged Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 天子遣諫議大夫張顗至晉州諭全忠，令與太原通和。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven sent Remonstrance Official Zhang Yi to Jinzhou to instruct Quanzhong to make peace with Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Zhang Yi to urge peace with Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 屬友甯再戰不利，乃還關西。

translations.literal: As Youning again fought to disadvantage he returned to Guanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Youning fought to disadvantage and returned to Guanxi.

sentences.zh: 四月丁丑，硃友甯總大軍屯于興平。

translations.literal: On the fourth month, dingchou, Zhu Youning massed the great army at Xingping.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, dingchou: Youning massed at Xingping.

sentences.zh: 五月，岐軍出戰，大敗于武功南之漢穀。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Qi troops fought and were greatly defeated south of Wugong at Hang Valley.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: Qi troops were defeated at Hang Valley.

sentences.zh: 全忠聞捷，自引汴軍五萬西征。

translations.literal: Hearing the victory Quanzhong himself led fifty thousand Bian troops west.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing victory Quanzhong led fifty thousand west.

sentences.zh: 六月，進營虢縣。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he advanced camp to Guo County.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: he camped at Guo County.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，進圍鳳翔，遣判官入城迎駕。

translations.literal: On dinghai he advanced to besiege Fengxiang and sent a judge into the city to welcome the carriage.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he besieged Fengxiang and sent a judge welcome the carriage.

sentences.zh: 九月，岐軍出戰，又敗。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Qi troops fought and were again defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Qi troops were again defeated.

sentences.zh: 十一月，鄜州節度使李周彝率眾救鳳翔。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Yanzhou Commissioner Li Zhouyi led troops to save Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: Li Zhouyi led troops to save Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸酉，汴將孔勍乘虛襲下鄜州，獲周彝妻子，周彝即以兵士來降。

translations.literal: On the twelfth month, guiyou, Bian general Kong Xun seized Yanzhou by surprise, took Zhouyi's wife and children; Zhouyi then came down with his soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, guiyou: Kong Xun seized Yanzhou; Zhouyi surrendered.

sentences.zh: 於是邠、寧、鄜、坊等州皆陷於汴軍。

translations.literal: Thereby Bin, Ning, Yan, and Fang all fell to Bian troops.
translations.idiomatic: Bin, Ning, Yan, and Fang fell to Bian.

sentences.zh: 茂貞懼，謀誅內官以解。

translations.literal: Maozhen was afraid and plotted to kill the inner officials to resolve the crisis.
translations.idiomatic: Maozhen feared and plotted kill inner officials.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月癸卯朔，車駕在鳳翔。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tianfu, spring, the first month, on guimao, the first day, the imperial carriage was at Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Tianfu 3, spring, guimao new moon: the carriage was at Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，天子遣中使到全忠軍，茂貞亦令軍將郭啟奇來達上欲還京之旨。

translations.literal: On jiachen, the Son of Heaven sent inner envoys to Quanzhong's army; Maozhen also sent General Guo Qiqi to convey the wish to return to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen envoys went to Quanzhong; Maozhen sent Guo Qiqi.

sentences.zh: 丙午，青州牙將劉鄩陷全忠之兗州，又令牙將張厚入奏，是日，亦竊發于華州，殺州將婁敬思。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Qingzhou guard Liu Zan took Quanzhong's Yanzhou; another guard Zhang Hou entered memorial; that day he also struck at Hua, killing Prefect Lou Jingsi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Liu Zan took Yanzhou; Zhang Hou memorialized; Lou Jingsi was killed at Hua.

sentences.zh: 上又令戶部侍郎韓偓、趙國夫人寵顏宣諭于全忠軍。

translations.literal: The emperor again sent Vice Minister of Revenue Han Wo and Lady Zhao of Zhao to proclaim to Quanzhong's army.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Han Wo and Lady Zhao to proclaim to Quanzhong's army.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，全忠令判官李振入奏，上令翰林學士姚洎傳宣，令全忠喚崔胤令率文武百僚來迎駕。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Quanzhong sent Judge Li Zhen to memorialize; the emperor ordered Academician Yao Ji to proclaim ordering Quanzhong summon Cui Yin to lead civil and military officials to welcome the carriage.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Li Zhen memorialized; the emperor ordered Yin summoned welcome the carriage.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上令禮部尚書蘇循傳詔，賜全忠玉帶，仍令全忠處分蔣玄暉侍帝左右。

translations.literal: On guichou, the emperor ordered Minister of Rites Su Xun to proclaim, grant Quanzhong a jade belt, and order Quanzhong manage Jiang Xuanhui attending the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Su Xun granted Quanzhong a jade belt and ordered manage Jiang Xuanhui.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，蔣玄暉與中使同押送中尉韓全誨、張弘彥已下二十人首級，告諭四鎮兵士回鑾之期。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Jiang Xuanhui with inner envoys escorted the heads of Inner Commander Han Quanhui, Zhang Hongyan, and twenty below, announcing to the four commands' troops the date of return.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi twenty eunuch heads were escorted, announcing return.

sentences.zh: 戊午，遣中使走馬華州，追崔胤，胤托疾不至。

translations.literal: On wuwu, inner envoys galloped to Hua to pursue Cui Yin; Yin pleaded illness and did not come.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu envoys pursued Yin at Hua; he pleaded illness.

sentences.zh: 甲子巳時，車駕出鳳翔，幸全忠軍。

translations.literal: On jiazi at si hour the imperial carriage left Fengxiang and visited Quanzhong's army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi at si hour the carriage left Fengxiang for Quanzhong's army.

sentences.zh: 全忠素服待罪，泣下不自勝，上親解玉帶賜之。

translations.literal: Quanzhong in plain robes awaited punishment, weeping beyond control; the emperor personally unfastened the jade belt and gave it.
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhong in plain robes wept; the emperor gave back the jade belt.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，次扶風，令硃友倫總兵侍衛。

translations.literal: On yichou the court halted at Fufeng and ordered Zhu Youlun to command troops as guard.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou at Fufeng Zhu Youlun guarded.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，次武功。

translations.literal: On bingyin the court halted at Wugong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin they halted at Wugong.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，次興平，宰臣崔胤率百官迎謁。

translations.literal: On dingmao the court halted at Xingping; Grand Councilor Cui Yin led the hundred officials to welcome.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao at Xingping Yin led officials to welcome.

sentences.zh: 即日降制，以崔胤守司空、門下侍郎、平章事，復太清宮使、弘文館大學士、延資庫使、諸道鹽鐵轉運使、判度支，魏國公封邑如故。

translations.literal: That day a descending edict made Yin Guardian Minister of Works, Vice Director, Grand Councilor, restoring Grand Pure Palace, Hongwen, Extended Treasury, Salt and Iron Transport, and Revenue Control, Duke of Wei fief unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: That day Yin was restored grand councilor and duke of Wei.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，次咸陽。

translations.literal: On wuchen the court halted at Xianyang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen they halted at Xianyang.

sentences.zh: 己巳，入京師。

translations.literal: On jisi the court entered the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi they entered Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 天子素服哭于太廟，改服冕旒，謁九廟。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven in plain robes wept at the ancestral temple, changed to coronation robes, and visited the Nine Temples.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wept at the temple, changed robes, and visited the Nine Temples.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，禦長樂樓，大赦，百僚稱賀。

translations.literal: When rites ended he faced Changle Gate, amnestied, and the hundred officials congratulated.
translations.idiomatic: He amnestied at Changle Gate; officials congratulated.

sentences.zh: 全忠處左軍。

translations.literal: Quanzhong was posted to the Left Army.
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhong took the Left Army post.

sentences.zh: 辛未，宴全忠於內殿，內第子奏樂。

translations.literal: On xinwei he feasted Quanzhong in the inner hall; inner consorts' sons performed music.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he feasted Quanzhong in the inner hall.

sentences.zh: 是日，制內官第五可範已下七百人並賜死於內侍省，其諸道監軍及小使，仰本道節度使處斬訖奏，從全忠、崔胤所奏也。

translations.literal: That day an edict: seven hundred inner officials from Di Wu and below were all ordered to die in the Inner Service Bureau; circuit supervisors and lesser agents were to execute and memorialize—following Quanzhong and Yin's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: That day seven hundred eunuchs were ordered die—per Quanzhong and Yin.

sentences.zh: 帝悲惜之，自為奠文祭之。

translations.literal: The emperor mourned them and himself composed funeral text.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor mourned and composed funeral text.

sentences.zh: 二月壬申朔。

translations.literal: In the second month, on renshen, the first day.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, renshen new moon.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，制賜全忠「回天再造竭忠守正功臣」名。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, an edict granted Quanzhong the title "Turn Heaven Renew Create Exhaust Loyal Upright Merit Holder."
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Quanzhong received Turn Heaven Renew Create merit title.

sentences.zh: 己卯，制以輝王祚充諸道兵馬元帥。

translations.literal: On jimao, an edict made Prince of Hui Zuo Commander-in-Chief of All Circuits' Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Prince of Hui Zuo was made commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 又制以回天再造竭忠守正功臣、宣武宣義天平護國等軍節度使、汴宋亳輝河中晉絳慈隰鄭滑潁鄆齊曹等州觀察處置等使、太清宮修葺宮闕制置度支解縣池場等使、開府儀同三司、檢校太師、守中書令、河中尹、汴滑鄆等州刺史、上柱國、梁王、食邑九千戶、食實封六百戶硃全忠守司徒，兼侍中、判六軍十二衛。

translations.literal: Another edict made Merit Holder Zhu Quanzhong Guardian Minister of Works, concurrent Palace Attendant, Controller of Six Armies and Twelve Guards.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict made Quanzhong guardian minister of works and controller of six armies.

sentences.zh: 以吏部尚書、平章事裴樞檢校右僕射，同平章事，兼廣州刺史、可守太尉、中書令，充諸道兵馬副元帥，進邑三千戶。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel and Grand Councilor Pei Shu was made Acting Right Vice Director, Grand Councilor, concurrent Guangzhou Prefect, could keep Grand Guardian and Director of the Secretariat, Vice Commander-in-Chief, fief increased three thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Shu was made vice commander-in-chief and Guangzhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 以宰臣崔胤清海軍節度、嶺南東道觀察等使。

translations.literal: Grand Councilor Cui Yin was made Qinghai Commissioner and Lingnan East Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yin was made Qinghai commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，制以門下侍郎、兵部尚書、同平章事、監修國史陸扆責授沂王傅分司。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, an edict demoted Vice Director Lu Yi to Lecturer for Prince of Yi, detached service.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Lu Yi was demoted to Prince of Yi lecturer.

sentences.zh: 己丑，上宴全忠於壽春殿。

translations.literal: On jichou the emperor feasted Quanzhong at Shouchun Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he feasted Quanzhong at Shouchun Hall.

sentences.zh: 又令全忠與茂貞書，取平原公主。

translations.literal: He again ordered Quanzhong write Maozhen for Princess Pingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Quanzhong write Maozhen for Princess Pingyuan.

sentences.zh: 同州節度使趙翊、陝州節度使硃友謙來朝。

translations.literal: Tongzhou Commissioner Zhao Yi and Shanzhou Commissioner Zhu Youqian came to audience.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yi and Zhu Youqian came to audience.

sentences.zh: 制以硃友裕為華州刺史，充感化軍節度使。

translations.literal: An edict made Zhu Youyu Hua Prefect and Commissioner of Ganhua Army.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Zhu Youyu Ganhua commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙未，會鞠于保甯殿，全忠得頭籌，令內弟子送酒，仍面賜副元帥官告。

translations.literal: On yiwei, a ball game was held at Baoning Hall; Quanzhong won the lead token, ordered inner consorts' sons bring wine, and face-to-face granted the vice commander-in-chief's commission.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei at Baoning Hall Quanzhong won the lead token and granted Pei Shu's commission.

sentences.zh: 以新除廣州節度使裴樞為門下侍郎、吏部尚書、平章事、監修國史；

translations.literal: Newly appointed Guangzhou Commissioner Pei Shu was made Vice Director, Minister of Personnel, Grand Councilor, Commissioner for Editing the National History;
translations.idiomatic: Pei Shu was made vice director and grand councilor;

sentences.zh: 以戶部侍郎王溥同平章事。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Revenue Wang Pu was made Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Pu was made grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，全忠歸大樑，上宴之內殿，置酒於延喜門。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Quanzhong returned to Daliang; the emperor feasted him in the inner hall and set wine at Yanxi Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Quanzhong returned to Daliang; the emperor feasted him at Yanxi Gate.

sentences.zh: 是日，全忠與四鎮判官皆預席，上臨軒泣別，又令中使走送禦制《楊柳枝》詞五首賜之。

translations.literal: That day Quanzhong and the four commands' judges all attended; the emperor faced the hall weeping farewell and ordered inner envoys gallop to send five composed "Willow Branch" lyrics as gift.
translations.idiomatic: That day judges attended; the emperor wept farewell and sent five "Willow Branch" lyrics.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，平原公主至京師。

translations.literal: On xinchou Princess Pingyuan reached the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Princess Pingyuan arrived.

sentences.zh: 三月壬寅朔，全忠引四鎮之兵征王師範。

translations.literal: In the third month, on renyin, the first day, Quanzhong led four commands' troops against Wang Shifan.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, renyin new moon: Quanzhong led four commands against Wang Shifan.

sentences.zh: 先是，大將硃友甯、楊師厚前軍臨淄、青，師範求援于淮南，楊行密遣將王景仁帥眾萬人赴之。

translations.literal: Before this, generals Zhu Youning and Yang Shihou's vanguard reached Linzi and Qing; Shifan begged Huainan aid; Yang Xingmi sent Wang Jingren with ten thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: Before this Youning and Yang Shihou reached Linzi; Shifan begged Huainan aid.

sentences.zh: 四月辛未朔，西川王建以兵攻秦、隴，乘茂貞之弱也，仍遣判官韋莊入貢，修好于全忠。

translations.literal: On the fourth month, xinwei, the first day, Sichuan Wang Jian attacked Qin and Long, seizing Maozhen's weakness, and sent Judge Wei Zhuang to present tribute and seek good relations with Quanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, xinwei new moon: Wang Jian attacked Qin and Long and sent Wei Zhuang to Quanzhong.

sentences.zh: 五月，制鳳翔隴右四鎮北庭行軍、彰義軍節度、涇原渭武觀察處置押蕃落等使、開府儀同三司、守尚書令、兼侍中、鳳翔尹、上柱國、秦王李茂貞可檢校太師、守中書令。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, an edict: Fengxiang Longyou Four Commands Northern Court Campaign, Zhangyi Commissioner Li Maozhen could be Acting Grand Preceptor, Guardian Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: Maozhen was made acting grand preceptor—he had feared Quanzhong's grand guardian rank.

sentences.zh: 初，茂貞淩弱王室，朝廷姑息，加尚書令，及是全忠方守太尉，茂貞懼，乞罷尚書令故也。

translations.literal: At first Maozhen had bullied the royal house; the court indulged him and added Director of the Department of State Affairs; now Quanzhong held Grand Guardian and Maozhen feared and begged leave the directorate.
translations.idiomatic: Maozhen had bullied the court; now he begged leave the directorate.

sentences.zh: 崔胤奏：「六軍十二衛名額空存，實無兵士。

translations.literal: Cui Yin memorialized: "The Six Armies and Twelve Guards exist in name only with no soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Yin wrote: "Six Armies and Twelve Guards are names without soldiers.

sentences.zh: 京師侍衛，亦藉親軍。

translations.literal: Capital guard also relies on personal troops.
